The company distributes newsprints, printing papers, and information-related papers; container and folding box boards; surface materials, adhesives, and release papers and films; pulp and recovered papers; packaging materials, including corrugated, air cushions, honeycomb panels, bag type air cushioning materials, foam and paper cushions, gap filing buffer materials, and corrugated foam products; ink large format inkjet printers; and media for signage, interior decoration, and car wrapping. It also owns real estate; leases warehouses; and manufactures paper yarn fibers. In addition, the company offers town ecomo, a system in which paper from households is brought into collection boxes in supermarkets and retail stores to be recycled as paper raw material; office ecomo, a system for safely and securely collecting confidential documents from offices in dedicated boxes to be recycled as paper raw material; ecomo closed recycle service, a service spanning from the proposal to development of sustainable, rational, and feasible closed recycling schemes; and BMecomo, a system aimed to help operation control, facilities management, and business administration of biomass power plants. The company was formerly known as Kokusai Pulp&Paper Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Kpp Group Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2022. Kpp Group Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1924 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

2613.d: J-Oil Mills, Inc. manufacture and sell vegetable oils and fats in Japan. The company operates through Oils and Fats Business, Specialty Foods Business, and others segments. It is involved in manufacturing, processing, and sales of oils and fats, fats and oil cake, starch, feed and fertilizer, and other various foods; cultivation, development, processing, and sales of agricultural products; sale of food manufacturing equipment; and real estate rental business. The company also offers proteins. J-Oil Mills, Inc. was founded in 1826 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

255A.d: Gltechno Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in analytical instruments, Semiconductors, automated recognition, and related businesses. It offers liquid and gas chromatography, antenna separated and integrated module, wall-mounted reader/writer, desktop USB reader, security cabinet, face recognition system, reagent management system, IC cards, label-type tags, and processing tags. The company was founded in 2024 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

5036.d: Japan Business Systems, Inc. provides cloud integration and related services. The company operates through three segments: Cloud Integration, Cloud Service, and License & Products. It develops, implements, establishes, and monitors cloud migration plans; implements Microsoft Cloud services; and offers maintenance, operation, and support services to enhance cloud utilization, focusing on Microsoft Cloud. The company also engages in the provision of cloud solutions, licenses, equipment for on-premise infrastructure, and private cloud services; and resale of related equipment. In addition, it offers Microsoft 365; Microsoft power platform; security; cloud manufacture solutions; hybrid meetings; global business support services; and Microsoft dynamics 365. Japan Business Systems, Inc. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

3151.d: Vital KSK Holdings, Inc. engages in the wholesale and retail sale of pharmaceutical products in Japan. The company sells poisonous or deleterious substances, narcotics, quasi-drugs, medical equipment and devices, sanitary materials, hygiene goods, nursing care products, and beverages; and test reagents, agricultural chemicals, epidemiological agents and materials, industrial chemicals, veterinary drugs, paints, pigments, dyes, regenerative medicine products, and other chemicals, as well as well as chemicals for scientific use. It is also involved in the operation pharmacies; provision of medical management consulting services for medical institutions such as hospitals, nursing care providers, and local governments; wholesale of agricultural chemicals and agricultural materials; nursing care-related business; rental and sales of welfare equipment and home modification; general freight vehicle transportation activities; and insurance agency, real estate management, and parking lot operation businesses. Vital KSK Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Setagaya, Japan.

166A.d: TASUKI Holdings Inc. engages in the real estate business in Japan. It operates Life Platform that plans, develops, and sells IoT residential, logistics, and other properties, as well as provides solutions for investment and asset management purposes. The company also provides real estate secured loans; asset consulting for real estate owners; real estate crowdfunding services; formation and management of real estate funds; and acquisition, renovation, management, and sale of vacant properties. In addition, it develops and sells DX products for the real estate industry. TASUKI Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2024 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

575A.d: MAEZAWA Holdings CO.,LTD., through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of water supply and sewage-related products. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7231.d: Topy Industries, Limited engages in the steel, automotive, industrial machinery components, and other businesses in Japan. It provides section steel, such as H-section steel, channel steel, equal and unequal angle steel, unequal non-isopachous steel, flat steel, R-flat steel, bulb plate, ultra-thick wide flat, and deformed section steel products, including rims, super giant off-the-road rim wheels, track shoes, forklift mast materials, segment components, HSST rails, and Z-steel products, as well as deformed bar steel products and compact coil TACoil. The company also offers steel wheels, aluminum wheels, and construction machinery wheels for passenger cars, trucks, buses, and construction machinery; and undercarriage components, such as tracks, rollers, cutting edges for motor graders, and city pads, as well as shoes, links, pins, and bushes parts. In addition, it provides crawler robots and synthetic mica products. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

9534.d: Hokkaido Gas Co., Ltd. engages in gas business in Japan. It is also involved in the purification and sale of gas by-products; heat and power supply businesses; production and sale of gas appliances, as well as related construction works; and other related works. The company was incorporated in 1911 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

9743.d: Tanseisha Co., Ltd. engages in the research, planning, design, layout, production, construction, and operation of commercial, public, hospitality, event, and business and cultural spaces in Japan. The company's research and planning services comprise consulting, research and analysis, planning, coordination, branding, and project management; and design and layout services comprising design concept, basic layout, and execution design, as well as the proposal for creative media spaces. Its production and construction services comprising design supervision, production and construction, and technical direction for chain stores, such as fashion and fast-food stores, and multimedia spaces; and operation services, which include operational planning and maintenance, and promotional planning, as well as assessment, inspection, and effectiveness measurement. In addition, the company engages in rental and sales of office equipment, human resources support, website utilization, advertising, and information provision services. Tanseisha Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4109.d: Stella Chemifa Corporation manufactures and sells high-purity chemical products in Japan and internationally. It offers hydrofluoric acid, ammonium fluoride, buffered hydrofluoric acid, HG series, and etching solutions used in semiconductors and liquid crystal products; calcium, aluminum, lithium, strontium, barium, magnesium, lead fluoride and fluoride nanoparticles used in optical materials; and lithium hexafluorophosphate and fluoride nanoparticles for batteries. The company also provides boron trifluoride, boron trifluoride diethyl ether, boron trifluoride dimethyl ether, boron trifluoride n-butyl ether, boron trifluoride tetrahydrofuran, boron trifluoride phenol, boron trifluoride monoethyl amine, boron trifluoride piperidine, and triethylamine 3HF used in reactive catalysts; and hydrofluoric acid, ammonium fluoride, ammonium hydrogenfluoride, and borofluoride used in surface treatment and alternatives for CFCs. In addition, it offers potassium fluoroborate and boric acid for nuclear energy applications; tin fluoride (II) USP used in GMP-compliant products; and other products, such as potassium fluoride, calcium fluoride, potassium hexafluorozirconate, potassium hexafluorotitanate, sodium fluoride, potassium fluorosilicate, sodium hexafluorosilicate, magnesium hexafluorosilicate, fluoroboric acid, zinc fluoroborate, potassium fluorosilicate, tin fluoroborate, copper fluoroborate, sodium fluoroborate, lead fluoroborate, ammonium hydrogenfluoride, and potassium hexafluorophosphate. Further, the company transportation business, including shipping, custom brokerage, warehousing, and container services. Additionally, it develops Boron Neutron Capture therapy for the treatment of cancer. The company was formerly known as Hashimoto Chemical Corporation and changed its name to Stella Chemifa Corporation in 1997. Stella Chemifa Corporation was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

7412.d: ATOM Corporation engages in the restaurant business in Japan. It manages owned and franchised restaurants, including steakhouses, izakaya, conveyor-belt sushi, yakiniku, Japanese, western, and tonkatsu restaurants, as well as cafes establishments. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

4078.d: Sakai Chemical Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells various chemical products in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, the Middle East, and internationally. It operates through Electronic Materials; Cosmetic Materials; Organic Chemicals; Sanitary Materials; Contract Processing; Titanium Oxide and Zinc Products; Resin Additives; Catalyst; Inorganic Material; Medical Business; and Others. The company offers titanium dioxide used in a range of applications, including paints, printer inks, paper manufacturing, plastics, chemical fibers, rubber, porcelain enamel, optical glass, and capacitors; barium and strontium salt products; and zinc oxide for electronic materials, cosmetics, and heat-dissipation. It also provides plastic additives, such as metallic soap, hydrotalcite, and flame retardants, as well as calcium/zinc-based composite stabilizers; catalysts comprising De-NOx/De-DXN, hydrogenation, titanium catalysts for polyester polymerization, titanium dioxide for catalyst carriers, and catalysts for raw materials of synthetic fibers; and electronic materials, which includes dielectric and piezoelectric ceramics, spherical silica, and secondary batteries and electrode materials. In addition, the company offers cosmetic raw materials, such as titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, barium, calcium, water repellent pigments, and cosmetic inorganic fluorescent materials; pharmaceuticals, comprising prescription and OTC drugs, health foods, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and pharmaceutical intermediates. Further, it provides organic chemical products containing sulfur and phosphorus for electronics, resin materials, healthcare, lubricants, and water treatment materials sectors; and road marking materials for compartment lines, road markings, expressways, and braille sheets. The company exports its products. Sakai Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

5202.d: Nippon Sheet Glass Company, Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of glass and glass products in Europe, Asia, and the Americas. The company operates through Architectural, Automotive, Technical Glass, and Other segments. It offers flat glass and various interior and exterior glazing products within commercial and residential markets; and glass for the solar energy sector. The company also provides automotive products, including front and rear door, front and rear quarter, and front and rear vent glasses; and windshield, sunroof, and rear window glasses; and distributes glass for light, medium and heavy duty commercial vehicles, as well as off-road vehicles, bus and coach, and marine and rails. In addition, it offers information and telecommunication devices; functional products under the MICROGLAS brand name; and fine glass products, such as thin sheets, special glass for chemical strengthening, and anti-glare glass products. The company was formerly known as America Japan Sheet Glass Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Sheet Glass Company, Limited in 1931. The company was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4221.d: Okura Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells polyethylene and polypropylene products in Japan. It operates through three segments: Synthetic Resin Business, New Material Business, and Construction Materials Business. It offers plastic packaging film for food and other packaging to industrial materials; and Lamitop Masker HR, a masking film used for two-tone color automotive roof. The company also provides thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer film under the Silklon brand name; and solventless acrylic adhesive, including anaerobic adhesives, UV curable adhesive, and two-component curing adhesive under the Yumen Brand name. In addition, it offers optical functional films, particle board, engineered wood boards, plywood, and other engineered wood products; and engages in lumber processing and housing site development business, as well as sells housing. The company's products are used in electronic information, automotive, and medicine and welfare industries. Okura Industrial Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shikoku Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Okura Industrial Co., Ltd. in November 1955. Okura Industrial Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Marugame, Japan.

6794.d: Foster Electric Company, Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells loudspeakers, audio equipment, and electronical equipment in Japan, China, the United States, rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Speaker, Mobile Audio, and Other. The company offers various speaker products, including automotive, reflow, micro, USB, general, flat-screen TVs, and 2 in 1 vibration, as well as speaker systems. It also provides mobile audio products, such as mobile phone headsets, headphones, earphones, Bluetooth headsets, and earphone drivers, as well as vibration actuators. In addition, the company offers automotive components and products comprising alarm, eCall, audio, and acoustic vehicle alerting system speakers, as well as actuators, headphones, and alarm buzzers; small acoustic components, such as magnetics buzzers and sounders for alarm sounds; products under the Fostex brand; and logistics services. Foster Electric Company, Limited was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Akishima, Japan.

9900.d: Sagami Holdings Corporation is engaged in the development of chains of Japanese and noodle restaurants in Japan, Vietnam, and Italy. It operates restaurants under the Sagami, Ajino-Mingei, Don Don An, Aiso-Ya, CHOSUKE, NIDAIME CHOSUKE, SUIZAN, JINJIN, SAGAMI, BINMUGI, BUBUKA, Sagami Issha, SAGAMI VIETNAM, and SAGAMI Milano Centrale names. The company is also involved in the management of restaurants; manufactures, processes and sales of noodles; franchise business; management of overseas outlets; manages the Tenobe Udon specialty restaurant, Ajino-Mingei, and other specialty restaurant chains; manufacture, processes, sales, and import/export of ingredients, food and restaurant-related materials, cut vegetables, sauces and soups, and delicatessen; provision of sales support and business promotion services; and product development work. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

6676.d: Buffalo Inc., through its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells digital home appliances and computer peripherals in Japan and internationally. The company offers Wi-Fi, Wired LAN, Hard Disk) / NAS, SSD, Blu-ray/DVD/CD drive, memory, USB memory, memory cards/card readers/writers, audio/visual equipment, cable, mouse, keyboard and input devices, web camera/headset, smartphone accessories, tablet accessories, power supply related products, accessories and storage, tv accessories, and other peripherals. It is involved in Development, manufacturing and sales of equipment, construction, installation and maintenance of network infrastructure, data recovery services, and network storage; development and sales of storage software and direct marketing; exchange services and data; manufacture and sale of erasing products; planning, development, sales, and sales of audio equipment and related products; and procurement and management of materials. The company was formerly known as Melco Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Buffalo Inc. in April 2025. Buffalo Inc. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7818.d: TRANSACTION CO.,Ltd. plans, designs, manufactures, and sells miscellaneous goods to companies and individuals in Japan and internationally. The company offers eco products that include reusable products made from organic cotton, recycled materials, biomass plastics, and natural materials, as well as upcycled finished goods; lifestyle products, including picture-style towels, acrylic products, suitcases, suitcase belts, and pet wear and related finished goods; and wellness products comprising sanitary products, such as masks. It also provides silk screen printing; on demand printing; graphic design; and web design services. The company sells its products through e-commerce and website to the end users, wholesalers, and others. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4417.d: Global Security Experts Inc. operates as a cybersecurity education company in Japan. It offers security consulting and vulnerability diagnosis, as well as other security solutions. The company also offers system engineering services in security personnel. Global Security Experts Inc. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

7128.d: UNISOL Holdings Corporation engages in the machinery and tools, construction machinery and materials, and IoT businesses in Japan. The company sells industrial machinery, equipment, and tools, such as machine tools, press machines, injection molding machines, robots, logistics machines, and other equipment; and screws, hardware, welding materials, painting materials, and machine tools for steel frame construction companies, as well as turnbuckles, braces, and plumbing materials for plant plumbers. It offers surveillance camera systems, security systems, and access control. In addition, the company is involved in the renting and sale of construction machinery, such as cranes, excavators, foundation construction machinery, and high-altitude work vehicles, as well as related peripheral equipment; and rental of machine with operator. UNISOL Holdings Corporation was formerly known as Maruka Furusato Corporation and changed its name to UNISOL Holdings Corporation in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

5946.d: Chofu Seisakusho Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells residential appliances under the Chofu and Sunpot brands in Japan. The company offers water heaters comprising oil water heaters, oil bath boilers, gas water heaters, gas bath boilers, electric water heaters, and EcoCute heat pump water heaters; air conditioning equipment consisting of oil stoves, gas stoves, hot water heating systems, geothermal heat pumps, and snow melting systems; and system equipment, such as system bathrooms, artificial marble bathtubs, and system kitchens. It also provides solar equipment, including solar water heaters, solar-powered hot water systems, solar underfloor ventilation fans, and solar photovoltaic and solar thermal hybrid modules; kitchen-related products; agricultural equipment; and centralized control systems. In addition, the company is involved in engineering services, such as proposing, designing, and constructing energy-efficient thermal energy supply systems; maintenance of central heating systems; installation of oil and gas equipment; maintenance of various systems; and software development and sales. It exports its products to Europe, North America, and Oceania. Chofu Seisakusho Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Shimonoseki, Japan.

1822.d: Daiho Corporation engages in the civil engineering and construction business in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the design, supervision, and consultation of civil engineering and construction works; research, survey, and design of hydroelectric power generation; design and construction using pneumatic caisson method; design, manufacture, repair, sale, and lease of construction machinery; real estate sales, leasing, management, and brokerage; and research, design, and consultation related to regional and urban development, and other land use. It also provides environmental restoration services, including soil and water purification; industrial waste collection, transportation, treatment, and reuse services; and consulting, and other services. Daiho Corporation was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

4419.d: Finatext Holdings Ltd. engages in the fintech solution, big data analysis, and financial infrastructure businesses in Japan. The company provides Cloud-native and API based financial infrastructure. It also develops front-end applications, such as mobile apps. In addition, it offers financial education, demo trading, and other services through website and smartphone apps. Further, the company provides data to the financial and real estate industries, and data and artificial intelligence solutions. Finatext Holdings Ltd. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6993.d: Daikokuya Holdings Co.,Ltd. operate pawnbroker business in Japan. It operates through the Electrical Equipment Business and Pawnbroking and Secondhand Goods Sales Business segments. The company offers industrial lighting fixtures, which include explosion-proof type and sealed anti-corrosion lighting equipment, hand lamp and emergency /portable explosion proof lighting equipment; industrial electric circuit plumbing fittings, such as explosion-proof type, enclosed, and waterproof electric circuit piping fixture, pull box, and waterproof flexible tube; control equipment, such as connectors; and various OEM products. It also engages in the purchase and sale of second-hand branded goods, which include bags, watches, and jewelry. The company was formerly known as Asia Growth Capital, Ltd. and changed its name to Daikokuya Holdings Co.,Ltd. in August 2016. Daikokuya Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

It also provides recruiting services, such as en AGENTS that offers professional and specialized support services; Lighthouse, a word-of-mouth site for company review sites; CAREER HACK, a career information site for professionals in web and IT industries; job information sites; and Video Interview, and on demand video interview platform to easily screen candidates. In addition, the company operates en JINJI NO MIKATA, a recruitment support services for HR professionals; en COLLEGE for employee education services; engage, a website for recruitment support tool; HR OnBoard, an employee retention risk identification tool; and 3E TEST for assessing the talent pool, as well as provides evaluation and education consulting services. The company was formerly known as en-japan inc. and change its name to en Inc. in October 2025. en Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2329.d: Tohokushinsha Film Corporation operates as media business company in Japan. It operates through Advertising Production, Content Production, Media, and Properties segments. The company develops and produces feature films and drama series for television; animations and games; and dubbing/subtitling activities. It is also involved in the commercial and promotion planning/production, creative agency, broadcasting and streaming, localization, and licensing and merchandising services; digital production; sale of video equipment; import of fabrics for interiors; and production of sake. Tohokushinsha Film Corporation was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6339.d: Sintokogio,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells foundry, surface treatment, casting, environmental, conveying, special machinery, and other equipment in Japan, China, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company engages in electronic core materials and ceramics businesses. It also offers green sand and v-process molding, chemically bonded sand, and aluminium casting products; dust collection and fire prevention system, exhaust gas and water treatment products; powder treatment products and technologies; and force sensors. In addition, it provides flooring and electric cylinders, as well as image processing measuring machines and calibration of measuring instruments and machines. Further, it provides shot and air blasting machines, shot peening machines, barrel and precision brush polishing equipment, high-precision micro-machining equipment, surface evaluation equipment, surface treatment parts, abrasives, polishing, materials, etc.; mold molding and V process equipment, core molding and casting sand treatment equipment, and automatic pouring and sand coating equipment; casting equipment and parts, powder and granular processing equipment, wear-resistant castings, etc; dust collectors, deodorizers, wastewater treatment equipment, VOC gas purification equipment, and environmental business components; lifting devices, step-climbing machines; and organic EL panel manufacturing equipment and automated lines. Additionally, it provides dispersizers, battery raw material supply equipment, 3D equipment, 3D printers, ceramic products, molding equipment, automotive door assembly equipment, metal magnetic powders, sterile environment provision equipment; and special machinery business parts, nursing care and welfare products, etc. The company was formerly known as Kubota Seisakusho, Ltd. and changed its name to Sintokogio,Ltd. in February 1960. Sintokogio,Ltd. was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

6413.d: Riso Kagaku Corporation operates in printing equipment, real estate, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments: Printing Equipment Related Business and Real Estate Business. The company offers production printers, full-color inkjet printers, digital duplicators, and digital screen makers, as well as inkjet print engine under the VALEZUS, ComColor, GOCCOPRO, and RISOGRAPH names. It also engages in the leasing of buildings; the print creation and digital communication business; and the application software business. It offers its products to educational institutions, government and public agencies, companies, and local communities. Riso Kagaku Corporation was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6779.d: Nihon Dempa Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of crystal-related products in Japan, China, the United States, Germany, South Korea, Mexico, Romania, and internationally. The company also offers crystal units, crystal oscillators, frequency synthesizers, signal generators, millimeter-wave converters, synthetic quartz crystals, optical components, QCM outgas analysis system and real-time process monitor, outgas analysis systems, ultrasonic transducers, and SAW devices. ts products are used in various applications, space, infrastructure/industrial equipment, automotive, mobile, AV/OA, medical, healthcare, household appliance, and connectivity sectors. The company was formerly known as Nanbu Shoko Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nihon Dempa Kogyo Co., Ltd. in 1950. Nihon Dempa Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

8160.d: Kisoji Co., Ltd. operates restaurants in Japan. The company processes and provides food and beverages. It is also involved in real estate leasing activities. The company was formerly known as Matsuba Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kisoji Co., Ltd. in February 1974. Kisoji Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Nagoya, Japan.

2393.d: Nippon Care Supply Co., Ltd. engages in the rental and wholesale of welfare equipment businesses in Japan. The company rents or sells welfare equipment, including electric beds, wheelchairs, and bathing aids. The company also offers nursing care and diaper delivery services, as well as meal services for nursing care providers. Nippon Care Supply Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

4365.d: Matsumoto Yushi-Seiyaku Co., Ltd. produces and supplies surface active agents and polymers in Japan, China, Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. It offers spin finishes for extrusion spinning, textile spinning, and functional surface treatment of fibers; sizing chemicals for weaving; knitting and weaving lubricants; scouring agents and detergents; and dyeing and processing auxiliaries, including moisture management, antistatic, water-repellent finishing, anti-soiling, flame-retardants, and anti-light-fastness agents. The company also provides thermo-expandable microcapsules; microbeads; three-dimensional copying systems; anti-tack powder for batch off and inner parting lubricants for bladder-tire parting; modifiers, antistatic agents, anti-fogging agents, and lubricants for plastic materials; emulsifiers, base materials for shampoo and body soaps, fragrance and oil solubilizing agents, and pearl forming agents; chemicals for civil engineering and construction; and chemicals for environment conservation. Its products are used in information and electronics, automobile, precision instruments, civil engineering, construction, rubber, plastics, cosmetics, toiletries, and agriculture industries. The company was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Yao, Japan.

8935.d: FJ NEXT Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, development, sale, and brokerage of real estate properties in Japan. It operates in four segments: Real Estate Development, Real Estate Management, Construction, and Japanese Inn. The company is also involved in the development of condominiums and resorts; real estate management activities; design, construction, and renovation of building and detached houses; construction management and consulting business; and operation of inns under the Ito Yuki Tei, Ito Yuki Tei Kawana Bettei, Gyokuhokan, and Seiryuso names. In addition, it engages in non-life insurance agency business; restaurant business; cottage-area management operations; and provision of financial services, such as loans. The company was formerly known as FJ Next Co., Ltd. and changed its name to FJ NEXT Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2021. FJ NEXT Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6768.d: Tamura Corporation manufactures and sells electronic components, electronic components, electrochemical mounting, and information equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers electronic components, including transformers, reactors, choke coils, gate drivers, power supply modules, current sensors, AC adaptors, piezoelectric transformer, transducers, and ultrasonic sensors products. It also provides solder pastes, carbon pastes, solder sheet, photo-imageable solder masks, materials for display, photosensitive coverlay film, flux, and OSP; reflow oven and flow soldering systems, spray fluxer, and other related equipment; and broadcast studio and communication systems. Tamura Corporation was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2003.d: Nitto Fuji Flour Milling Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells flour products in Japan. The company offers wheat, bread, noodle, pasta, bran, mixed, alps, whole meal, and rye flour; and powders, hotcake high mix, and commercial frozen dough. It is also involved in warehousing business for storing wheat, and Kentucky Fried Chickens; and restaurant business. In addition, the company operates KFC franchisee in the Kanto and Tokai regions. The company was incorporated in 1914 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Nitto Fuji Flour Milling Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsubishi Corporation.

2938.d: Okamura Foods Co., Ltd. farms, produces, and sells salmon trout in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Aquaculture Business, Domestic Processing Business, Overseas Processing Business, and Overseas Wholesale Business segments. It also processes and sells herring roe and cod roe, as well as salmon roe, salmon sushi toppings for raw consumption, grilled fish, and boiled fish. In addition, the company wholesales marine products. Okamura Foods Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Aomori, Japan.

9517.d: eREX Co.,Ltd. engages in the electric power business in Japan and internationally. The company operates biomass power plants; and engages in a hydrogen power generation demonstration project. It is also involved in the development and production of biomass fuels from wood pellets; electricity trading; and electricity retailing to corporate and individual consumers. eREX Co.,Ltd. incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

9733.d: Nagase Brothers Inc. provides education services in Japan. The company operates through five segments: High School Students, Elementary and Junior High School, Sports Business, Business School, and Other Departments. It also offers swimming lessons and fitness gyms, as well as publishing, online schools, English schools for children, and an international business division. Nagase Brothers Inc. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Musashino, Japan.

6742.d: Kyosan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd. engages in the railway signal system business in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It offers railway signal solutions, including train control and detection equipment, interlocking equipment, block systems, field equipment, level crossing protection equipment, total traffic control systems, maintenance equipment, power supply for signaling systems, and railway-related equipment. The company also provides safeguards for passenger transfer areas such as partial height platform screen door, gap filler, falling detection devices, and warning devices; passenger information display devices and funeral display syatems; traffic management systems, such as road traffic control systems, road traffic signal controllers, road traffic signal units, traffic sensors, transmission systems, information displays, and other devices, as well as disaster-prevention products. In addition, it offers power conversion systems comprising digitally controlled RF systems and DC converters; uninterruptible power supplies for signal; and power supply for industrial equipment. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Denki Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kyosan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd. in 1926. Kyosan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

8157.d: Tsuzuki Denki Co., Ltd. engages in the design, development, construction, and maintenance of network and information systems. 5290.d: Vertex Corporation manufactures and sells concrete secondary products in Japan. The Concrete Business segment engages in flood prevention and sewerage projects that offer disaster prevention and mitigation solutions, including measures against flood disasters and earthquake resistance for sewerage facilities; road construction; railway business that offer hard concrete and special mortar; maintenance business; and housing and development business. This segment is also involved in the manufacture and sale of secondary concrete products, such as manholes, hume pipes, box culvert, and related products, as well as provision of installation work. Its Pile Business segment offers pre-tensioned spun high strength concrete, nodular, steel composite concrete, pre-tensioned and reinforced spun high strength concrete, and step tapered piles. This segment also engages in the manufacture and sale of centrifugal cupress concrete piles, as well as the carrying out of pile driving work. Its Slope Disaster Prevention Project segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of disaster prevention products, such as rockfall protection fences, as well as sale and installation of related products. The Others segment engages in the manufacture and sale of ceramic products, sale of hydraulic hoses, real estate rental, concrete investigation and testing, system development and sales, equipment rental and material sales, and RFID business. In addition, the company is involved in the lactic acid bacteria; concrete survey and testing; and system development and sales businesses. Vertex Corporation was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2918.d: Warabeya Nichiyo Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of food products for convenience stores in Japan, the United States, and internationally. It also procures, processes, and sells food ingredients; and sorts and delivers food products and ingredients. The company was formerly known as Warabeya Nichiyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Warabeya Nichiyo Holdings Co., Ltd. in September 2016. Warabeya Nichiyo Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

299A.d: Kurashiru, Inc. engages in the platform business in Japan, Singapore, and internationally. It offers advertising services, including Kurashiru, a recipe video platform; Receipt Challenge by Kurashiru, a smart savings app; Kurashiru AI OS, an AI agent platform for CPG brands, wholesalers, and retailers; TRILL, a lifestyle information media; and LIVEwith, a creator management agency. 6820.d: Icom Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells telecommunication equipment in Japan, the United States, Canada, Germany, Spain, Australia, China, and Vietnam. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

2931.d: Euglena Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of microalgae in Japan. It operates through there segments: Healthcare Business; Biofuel Business; and Other businesses. The company manufactures and sells health foods and cosmetics utilizing microalgae, such as euglena and chlorella. Further, the company provides genome analysis services. Euglena Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3679.d: ZIGExN Co., Ltd. operates the life service platform worldwide. The company provides vertical HR services such as, rejob; rejobcare; miraxs-sitter; Kensetsu-JOBs; Realestateworks; Ties; Dorapita; Recruitment Strategy & Execution/Operation; and ALPHA RESORT platforms. It also offers life services including, smocca; Sekaiproperty; Hikkoshi-EX; reshop-navi; reshop-navi exterior; reshop-navi gaiheki tosou; Gaiheki-concierge; enepi; Griene; Yeay; Hoken-Mammoth; renoco; Arubaito-ex; Matchingood-haken; Matchingood-Jinzai; CareerPlus; MyRec for MA/Retention Support; Bizcomi; Franchise-hikaku; appleworld; Travelist; BPO; Galantour; Rikisha; TASA; Chukosha-EX; Kuruma-kaitori-EX; TCV; SellTrade; Kekkon-sodansho-hikaku; Kateikyoshi-kuraberu; Ryugaku-kuraberu; fabiz; Hikakaku!; and Minaoshi platforms. 9278.d: Bookoff Group Holdings Limited operates secondhand book and other goods stores in the Japan, Malaysia, the United States, and France. It also operates BOOKOFF online e-commerce Website, which sells books, software, and other merchandise; and deals in books, CDs, DVDs, and games, as well as operates a book review community site. In addition, the company provides processing and consulting services related to employment of persons with disabilities. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.

1888.d: Wakachiku Construction Co., Ltd. engages in construction and real estate businesses. As of March 13, 2026, Wakachiku Construction Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of ASO Corporation.

7537.d: Marubun Corporation distributes electronics products in Japan and internationally. It also provides software products, such as cloud, enterprise software, embedded software, security, and OS/development tools; measuring equipment, tester monitoring, display/DLP, and others; inspection and analysis equipment, and other products; ICT solutions, including network and storage devices, simulator tester, server, service, security, and others; and assembly and robotics comprising assembly and mounting equipment, industrial robots, service robots, and others. The company also manufactures and sells printed materials; development and sales of web systems; research and development of software; development of map database; development and sales of package system; provides marketing and business solutions; and location-based services. 7777.d: 3-D Matrix, Ltd. developing, manufacturing, and selling self-assembling peptide technology in Japan and internationally. 2908.d: Fujicco Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells traditional Japanese processed food products in Japan. In addition, it offers Soracom Arc that connects devices to Soracom over WiFi, wired communication, and satellite; satellite messaging services; data and protocol management; data storage, visualization cloud integration; and private IoT networking services. The Valve segment offers various valves, such as 2-way ball, 3-way ball, 4-way ball, and diaphragm valves. The Other segment engages in the solar power generation business. 4554.d: Fuji Pharma Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and marketing of pharmaceutical products in Japan and internationally. 8614.d: Toyo Securities Co., Ltd. provides financial products trading services in Japan. It also leases office buildings, commercial facilities, and residual units. Nakano Corporation was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
