It offers authentication-based logon control, data access control, log collection system, and network isolation; and cybersecurity measures, cyber threat intelligence, data breach investigations, and CSIRT-related services. The company also develops and sells Smart-telecaster, a real-time image transmission system using 4G and 5G mobile lines; remote control of vehicles and heavy machinery; mixed analog and digital semiconductor devices; and special video transmission system. In addition, it provides various solutions, including security measures for educational and local government information systems; management of IT assets; telework and healthcare solutions; and internet isolation. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

8008.d: Yondoshi Holdings Inc. engages in the planning, manufacture, wholesale, and retail of jewelry, apparel, bags, and other products in Japan and internationally. The company offers jewelry products primarily under the 4°C name. It also plans, designs, and manufactures men's and women's wear and luxury watches. In addition, the company engages in the operation of fashion specialty stores and real estate leasing activities. Further, it is involved in managing a network of apparel specialty stores under Pallet brand. The company was formerly known as F&A Aqua Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Yondoshi Holdings Inc. in September 2013. Yondoshi Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

4718.d: Waseda Academy Co., Ltd. operates and manages preparatory schools for elementary, junior high, and high school students. The company operates schools; and franchise schools under the Kobetsu Shingakukan brand. Waseda Academy Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

1375.d: Yukiguni Factory Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells mushrooms and other food products under the Yukiguni brand name in Japan. Its products include Maitake Kiwami, Maitake Kiwami White, Eringi, Buna-Shimeji, Daikoku Hon-Shimeji, Tamba Shimeji, and button mushrooms; mushroom meat; health foods; and Maitake and Eringi rice mix. The company was formerly known as Yukiguni Maitake Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yukiguni Factory Co., Ltd. in April 2025. Yukiguni Factory Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Minamiuonuma, Japan.

3475.d: Good Com Asset Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, plans, develops, and sells condominiums under the GENOVIA brand in Japan and internationally. It operates through Wholesale, Retail Sales, Real Estate Management, Livenup Group, and Others segments. The company also provides building and rental property management services for condominiums; real estate consulting; property and casualty insurance; investment advice; investment trust asset management; financial instrument; IPO consulting for companies preparing for listing; and consulting services for listed companies regarding IR and capital policies, etc. In addition, it engages in real estate investment; real estate guarantor; development and sale of detached houses; renovation of old houses; and real estate fund business. Good Com Asset Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

9470.d: Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in educational, and healthcare and nursing business in Japan and internationally. The company operates classrooms for a range of children including preschoolers to junior high school students. It is also involved in publishing content business, such as issuing and selling publications through sales companies and bookstores; planning, production, purchasing, and sales of publications for kindergartens and nursery schools, childcare supplies, play equipment, apparel for teachers, etc.; and planning, development, and operation of nursing care service centers, mainly housing for the elderly with services. The company was formerly known as Gakken Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2009. Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

7914.d: Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the prepress, printing, bookbinding, and related ancillary businesses in Japan. It operates through Information Communication, Information Security, Living and Industrial Materials, and Other segments. The company engages in the planning and production of weekly, monthly, and quarterly magazines. It also offers paperbacks, collected works, textbooks, posters, calendars, advertising and promotional materials, decorative displays, and electronic books, as well as periodicals, books, general commercial printings, digital and in-store media, and digital communication services. In addition, the company provides bankbooks, business forms, securities, various cards, data printing, BPO, and payment solutions; paper containers, flexible packaging, blow bottles, metal and building material printing, electronic device components, and high-performance materials; and laminated tubes and tube containers for cosmetic, pharmaceutical, toothpaste, and food products. Further, it offers logistics, real estate management, packaging, transportation, and system development services. Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd. was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

3431.d: Miyaji Engineering Group,Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the construction and civil engineering activities in Japan. It is involved in the designing, production, erection, installation, maintenance, and repair of bridges, steel frames, and other steel structures; design and production of prestressed concrete; and design, manufacture, installation, sale, and repair of bridges, coastal structures, etc. The company also designs, manufactures, and installs steel structures; sells bolts and welding materials; and offers temporary staffing services, and other business operations, as well as solar power generation activities. Miyaji Engineering Group,Inc. was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

4377.d: ONE CAREER Inc. engages in the career data platform business. The company operates ONECAREER, a media that supports new graduate recruitment, as well as combines content that gathers information on job-hunting experiences; ONE CAREER PLUS, a job-seeking website; and ONE CAREER CLOUD to support the promotion of digital transformation in recruitment activities. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

6099.d: Elan Corporation engages in the nursing care business primarily in Japan. The company provides services for rental with laundry service of clothes, towels, diapers, and other daily necessities to persons admitted to hospital patients and nursing home residents. It also provides hospitalization and nursing care expenses guarantee services; and operates Elan Online Shop, a mail-order site for nursing care products. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Matsumoto, Japan. Elan Corporation is a subsidiary of M3, Inc.

7510.d: Takebishi Corporation operates as a technological trading company primarily in Japan. The company offers industrial equipment and systems, which includes factory automation (FA) devices, such as controllers, drive controls, and electricity distribution controls; FA systems; and industrial equipment, which includes processing machinery and robots. It also provides semiconductors and devices including assembly manufacturers and electronic device makers; and home electronics, such as PCs, controllers for industrial application, and other products for the amusement sector. In addition, the company operates social/information and communication business which offers cooling and heating equipment, building facilities comprising elevators and escalators, facilities for power and public utilities, and radiation equipment. Further, it provides information and communication equipment including sale of PCs and PC servers to the design, development, and maintenance of mission-critical systems, such as sales and production management systems; and security systems, which includes surveillance cameras and controls for entering and exiting comprising PBX. The company was formerly known as Takebishi Electric Sales Corp. and changed its name to Takebishi Corporation in September 2006. Takebishi Corporation was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

8151.d: TOYO Corporation provides measurement solutions in Japan. The company provides advanced measurement technologies for energy; equipment and solutions for measurement, analysis, and experimental data management to support research and development of transportation equipment such as automobiles and trains, as well as noise and vibration, and safety and durability of industrial machinery; and standard compliance testing services and solutions. It also offers test systems and analysis/monitoring systems; software development lifecycle products and services; and electromagnetic compatibility compliance testing and over the air measurement systems for 5G and connected vehicles, as well as installs, support, and maintains large parabolic antenna ground systems. In addition, the company provides ocean survey and measurement equipment for offshore, underwater, and submarine applications, as well as port areas; measurement technologies to cyber security products and services; and medical imaging solutions, including interpretation support systems for chest X-ray and CT images, and 2D and 3D preoperative digital planning tools in orthopedic surgery. Further, it develops customized products and autonomous driving/advanced driver assistance system. The company was formerly known as TOYO Trading Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TOYO Corporation in February 1977. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

1810.d: Matsui Construction Co., Ltd. engages in the civil engineering, designing, supervising, and construction business in Japan. The company undertakes shrines, temples, and cultural assets works, as well as government building, office building, education, research, culture, commerce, distribution, production, medical care, welfare, living space, and environmental arrangement. It also involved in the lumber and woodworking activities; manufacturing, processing, and selling of civil engineering and construction materials; owing, selling, leasing, trading, and management of real estate properties; property insurance agency; and brokerage services. In addition, the company manages sports, tourism, and leisure facilities; and engages in buying and selling of electricity and power generation business. Matsui Construction Co., Ltd. was founded in 1586 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

8699.d: HS Holdings Co., Ltd. provides merger and acquisition intermediary services in Japan. The company offers business succession consulting, business investment management, venture investment, and business revitalization consulting services. It also imports and exports watches and precious metals. The company was formerly known as Sawada Holdings Co., Ltd. HS Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

3010.d: Polaris Holdings Co., Ltd. operates a chain of hotels in Japan. It operates through the Hotel Management Business and Hotel Investment Business segments. The company operates its hotels under the KOKO HOTEL, Best Western, Value The Hotel, Hotel Wing, Tenza Hotel, and Red Planet Hotels brand names, as well as engages in franchise activities. It also provides tenant management services, and consulting and proposal services for investment in real estate properties. The company was formerly known as KachikaiHatsu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Polaris Holdings Co., Ltd. in March 2021. The company was incorporated in 1912 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

9052.d: Sanyo Electric Railway Co.,Ltd. engages in transportation and real estate businesses in Japan. The company operates through Transportation Segment; Distribution Industry; Real Estate Business; Rental Service; And Other Segments. It is involved in operating trains, buses, taxis, etc.; sale of products mainly in the department store business; leasing and sale of buildings and land; and restaurant business. The company offers railway information, such as operation information, deferred certificates, diamond search, fare search, timetable search, route map and station information, and information on fares and tickets; outing information, comprises hiking info, vacationers, and escorts; and real estate information, including apartments for rent, commercial facilities and office buildings; parking lot / bicycle parking lot; trunk room, properties and condominium for sale, and recruitment of land for business. Sanyo Electric Railway Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Akashi, Japan.

2325.d: NJS Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, primarily engages in water and environmental consulting, digital transformation, and customer services business in Japan and internationally. The company provides community and environmental solutions, including global environmental, water environment, urban development, and disaster prevention and mitigation solutions; infrastructure solutions comprising survey and planning of water supply and sewerage system, pipeline, treatment plant, infrastructure management, and management consulting; and survey and planning, infrastructure development, and operational capacity building support services. It also offers software, system construction and operation services, infrastructure management services, disaster prevention and mitigation, business operations, and AI utilization system; develops drones, robotics, sensors, and data analysis used for inspection; and customer service, such as information dissemination, customer relations, and communication services. The company was formerly known as Nippon Jogesuido Sekkei Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NJS Co., Ltd. in April 2015. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6718.d: Aiphone Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells telecommunications equipment for facilities, offices, and public facilities under the AIPHONE brand name in Japan and internationally. The company engages in the installation work, contracting, and repairs related to telecommunication; production of telecommunications equipment; and software development activities. It also offers general intercom devices for home and business use; security door intercoms and electronic locking systems; video door intercoms; healthcare intercom devices, such as nurse call and home care systems; and information transmission devices comprising living information display panels. Its products are used in residential properties, commercial buildings, medical facilities, accessories, and smartphone applications The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

4094.d: Nihon Kagaku Sangyo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial chemicals and building materials in Japan and internationally. It offers various inorganic metal products, including copper, tin, nickel, cobalt, bismuth, chromium, manganese, antimony, zinc, iron, and lithium compounds; organic metal compounds, such as metal acetylacetonate, metallic soaps, PUCAT, and PA series products; surface treatment agents; and other compounds. The company's chemical products are used in various industries, such as optical/precision instruments, electronics, ceramics, petrochemical catalysis, healthcare, and battery materials. It also develops fireproof, waterproof, and ventilation building materials; fabricated metal products; and heat exchangers, as well as offers stainless steel handrails and residential eaves; and pipe space covers and exterior products. The company was incorporated in 1924 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

2751.d: TENPOS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. operates kitchenware and equipment stores in Japan. The company provides designing, constructing, and management services for kitchen; and information and services for restaurant management; interior construction contracting; and financing services, such as leasing and credit. It also offers new and recycled cooking utensils, tableware, chairs, tables, kitchen equipment, etc.; and financing activities, such as sales of order entry systems, sales promotion consulting, temporary staffing, and M&A introductions, as well as operates restaurants and develop franchisees. The company was formerly known as Tenpos Busters Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TENPOS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. in November 2017. TENPOS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7723.d: Aichi Tokei Denki Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of water and gas meters, and related equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers liquid measurement products comprising electromagnetic water meters, residential water meters, portable and electronic water meters, capacitive electromagnetic flow sensors, compact electromagnetic flow sensors, flow sensors, microstream sensors, ovel gear flow sensors, instantaneous flow-rate/integrating flow volume flowmeters, small-size flow sensors, ultrasonic flow meters, and electromagnetic flow meters for agricultural applications. It also provides gas measurement products, such as ultrasonic flow meters for compressed air and nitrogen; ultrasonic flow meter for fuel gas; turbine gas meters for flow management; pressure-reducing valves; intelligent gas meters; digital manometers for town gas and LP gas; and systems. In addition, the company offers private-demand flow sensors and systems, including housing and building equipment and systems, instrumentations, precision machining and other parts. The company was formerly known as AICHI TOKEI MFG. CO., LTD. and changed its name to Aichi Tokei Denki Co., Ltd. in July 1912. Aichi Tokei Denki Co., Ltd. was founded in 1898 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

4392.d: Future Innovation Group, Inc. engages in the IoT and machines businesses in Japan. The company development, sales, rental, and leasing of mobile management systems, as well as associated communication and application services and maintenance, etc.; development, operation, and maintenance of multimedia systems for hotel operators, semiconductor substrate business, and manufacturing equipment business; and research, development, manufacturing, construction, maintenance management, sales, and import/export of unmanned aircraft and robot control systems. It also engages in the development and sales of in-house call recording systems and system contract development; development of logistics systems and virtual reality systems related solutions; development of payments, robotics, and information technology; maintenance and management of information and communications systems; tourist taxi/bus business and flat-rate taxi business; and rental/lease of Mobile Create products. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacturing and sales of Mobile Create products; provision of location information services in the transportation and logistics industries; and sales of hotel multimedia systems and procurement of materials. Further, it engages in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor and automobile related manufacturing equipment, dies, transport robots, etc. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Oita, Japan.

9539.d: Keiyo Gas Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, supply, and sale of gas in Japan. The company operates through Energy, Life Services, and Real Estate segments. It is also involved in the sale of gas equipment; and provision of gas construction and fitting services. The company provides its services to residential, commercial, industrial, and other customers. In addition, it engages in the sale of electricity; gas construction activities; and real estate rentals and other related activities. Keiyo Gas Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Ichikawa, Japan.

5410.d: Godo Steel, Ltd. manufactures and sells steel products in Japan. The company offers wire rods for tire chains, stapler needles, and fencing applications; H-beams and channels that are used in construction, civil engineering, and other sectors; structural bars, which are used as materials for making parts of construction and industrial machinery, ships, and other equipment; and rails. It also provides deformed bars, including screw rebars that are used as construction and civil engineering materials; EG joints and anchor plates, and friction welding; and billets. In addition, the company offers reinforcing bars, wire products, firebricks, and ballasts; trucking services; and industrial waste disposal services, as well as sells machinery, and raw materials for steel making. Further, it is involved in electric furnace dust disposal business; and manufacture and sale of crude zinc oxide, and organic and compound fertilizers. Godo Steel, Ltd. was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

6785.d: Suzuki Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells connectors for car electronics parts in Japan. It also offers precision press and mold dies, connector contacts and housings, connector contacts for automotive wire harnesses, machines for semiconductor later process, various customized machines, and medical instrument assembly products. The company also rents and sells electricity. In addition, it is involved in die manufacturing, component manufacturing, product system manufacturing, technical development, quality assurance businesses. Suzuki Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Suzaka, Japan.

4931.d: Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. engages in developing and selling cosmetics and healthcare products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Mail Order, Wholesale Sales, and Overseas Sales segments. It offers health food, such as supplements and green juice, as well as healthcare products that include medicine. The company also provides skincare products under the Perfect One, Perfect One Focus brands, Fun&Health, and TONOU brands; and pharmaceutical products for various diseases and symptoms. In addition, it operates a network of stores and online shops. Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shinnihonliving Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. in April 2002. Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Fukuoka City, Japan.

5074.d: Tess Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the engineering and energy supply businesses in Japan. The company involved in the engineering, procurement, and construction of energy conservation and renewable energy-related facilities. It also engages in the operations and maintenance of renewable energy power plants and renewable energy power generation; energy management, remote monitoring, and fuel supply services, as well as energy resource aggregation services, including supply-demand adjustment capacity, imbalance avoidance, rate reduction, and output suppression avoidance to general power transmission and distribution operators, power retailers, and consumers. In addition, the company offers intelligent energy infrastructure. It has installed capacity of approximately 398.6 MW for renewable energy power generation facilities, including 127 solar power plants, and 3 biomass power plant. The company was formerly known as Tess Techno Service Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tess Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2018. Tess Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

5976.d: Neturen Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel bars in Japan and internationally. It operates through Specialty Steel and Wire Products, Induction Heating, and Others segments. The company offers prestressed concrete (PC) steel bars, deformed PC steel bars, and shear reinforcement products for civil engineering and construction applications; high-strength spring steel wire (ITW) products for the use in suspension springs for automobiles and two-wheeled vehicles; automotive parts; construction machine parts; machining equipment; and pre-hardened wires. It is also involved in the manufacturing and sale of induction heating equipment and high-frequency hardening equipment; contract processing, manufacturing, and sale of high-frequency quenching of machine parts, etc.; provision of induction heat treatment services for critical safety parts of automobiles and machining equipment, etc.; and development of technical products business. In addition, the company leases movables and real estate properties. Neturen Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1940 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6145.d: Nittoku Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, sells, and services automatic winding machines, and related machinery and parts in Japan and internationally. The company offers coil type products, including relay, solenoid, ignition, transformer, injector, pick up, reactor, PM stepping, sensor, IH coil, power inductor, speaker/receiver, chip inductor, and common mode; and motor core type products comprising solid core inner and outer winding, segmented core, open core, and armature. It also provides bobbin coil winding machines comprising air-core perfect layer, flyer type air core coil, square wire edgewise, IH coil winding machine, and speaker coil winding assembly line; chip winding machines, such as chip and power inductor, common mode, multi-axis common mode coil winding machine, and inspection machine; and motor related machines. In addition, the company provides wire/cable manufacturing equipment, such as unwinding/winding machine, stranded wire winding machine, shield horizontal winding machine, taping equipment, and cable processing equipment; processing machines; and connector related equipment, such as terminal insertion and bending machine, and bending straightener. Further, it offers film/web transfer equipment, including high-speed intermittent film transfer machine, continuous film transfer, and multi capacitor winding machine; medical related automatic machine comprising stranded wire, catheter and guide wire winding, and laser stripping machine; other automated machinery, such as vehicle camera lens assembly machine, wire harness terminal automatic processing machine, and vehicle battery transfer equipment; and IC cards. The company was formerly known as Nittoku Engineering Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nittoku Co.,Ltd. in August 2019. Nittoku Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

5659.d: Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells stainless steel wires in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It offers stainless-steel wires, such as spring, micro, cold heading, shaft, weaving, and high alloy/titanium wires for use in vehicles, aircraft, office automation appliances, electric appliances, medical instruments, commodities, and leisure goods, as well as screws, steel nettings, etc. The company also offers filament yarn, cloth, tape, belt, felt, knit, sleeve, chop, and other metal fibers under the NASLON brand name. In addition, it provides filters, such as metal filters, including NASLON filters, NPM filters, EXCEL PORE, FINE MET, and re-washable systems for synthetic fiber, film, resin, nuclear and thermal power generation, petroleum refining, medical, and other applications; and semiconductor gas filters for process and bulk gases, component protection, integrated gas panels, and diffusers. Further, the company offers palladium alloy roll-plated hydrogen separation membrane for high purity hydrogen gas production and purification; high-strength copper-alloy wire for optical pickup and camera module; stainless steel wire for high corrosion resistant and heat resistant springs; hydrogen embrittlement resistant stainless steel spring wire; duplex stainless-steel wire for corrosion resistant springs, ropes, fasteners, wire mesh, etc.; and co-based alloy for medical use. The company was formerly known as The Sanshin Special Wire Manufacturing Company and changed its name to Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. in October 1956. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Daido Steel Co., Ltd.

5834.d: SBI Leasing Services Co., Ltd. engages in the arrangement and selling of investment funds in the operating lease business primarily focused on aircraft and ships. It operates through three segments: Aircraft Business, General Aviation Business, and Principal Investment Business. It engages in financial services, investment, asset management, crypto-assets, and next gen business. The company offers securities, banking, and insurance; asset management; fund management in multiple areas, including venture capital, leveraged buyout, and business succession; exchange and trading relating to digital assets; and business activities relating to biotechnology, healthcare and medical informatics, web 3, and new overseas markets. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Minato, Japan. SBI Leasing Services Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of SBI Holdings, Inc.

7637.d: Hakudo Co., Ltd. processes and sells metal and plastic materials in Japan, China, Thailand, and Vietnam. It offers aluminum tubes, copper, and stainless-steel plates, and bars; and elongated copper products, as well as special steel, titanium, and engineering plastics. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7840.d: France Bed Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, provides medical services in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Medical Services Business, and Home Furnishing and Health Business. It engages in the manufacturing, procurement, rental, and retail/wholesale sale of medical and nursing care beds, as well as welfare equipment; supply of linen to medical and welfare facilities, as well as hotels; and provision of facility solutions for medical and welfare facilities. The company is also involved in the design of mattresses; operation of showrooms for product experience and sleep consultation; and supply of beds, mattresses, and related products to hotels, inns, and other lodging operators. In addition, it engages in the sale of sundries; exhibition sale of furniture, fashion, and jewelry; manufacturing and sale of assorted beds and beddings, as well as special needs and home health equipment; maintenance, inspection, and repair of nursing-care and special needs equipment; storage of products and control of inventory; long-term care insurance welfare equipment rental business; daily-life care services in specified facilities; communal living care services for elderly with dementia; rental housing for elderly; and home renovation for home care. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

9368.d: Kimura Unity Co., Ltd. provides logistics, mobility, information, and staffing services in Japan, China, North America, and internationally. The company provides logistic services, such as distribution center operations, container equipment production, shipping operations, as well as warehousing and packing. It also offers vehicle management, maintenance, rental services, vehicle leasing, and insurance agency services. In addition, the company provides consulting/system development, and system maintenance. Further, it provides recruitment, temporary staffing, recruitment support services, and introduction dispatching. The company was formerly known as Kimura Unity and changed its name to Kimura Unity Co., Ltd. in November 1990. Kimura Unity Co., Ltd. was founded in 1881 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

5757.d: CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of brass rod and wire products in Japan, China, and Taiwan. It also offers precision parts through forging and machining activities; plumbing equipment under the CK brand; and hot-dip galvanized metal products. The company was formerly known as SAN-ETSU METALS Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. in October 2011. CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is based in Takaoka, Japan.

6630.d: Ya-Man Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, import, export, and sale of beauty and health equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers face, body, hair, shaver, and cosmetic products. It also imports and sell cosmetics and semiconductor inspection equipment, as well as sells household goods. It sells its products under the YA-MAN TOKYO JAPAN, myse, ONLY MINERALS, MINERAL air, and MAKANAI brands. The company sells its products through stores and online. Ya-Man Ltd. was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4743.d: ITFOR Inc. designs and develops software and system infrastructure in Japan. It procures and sells system equipment; and handles network and infrastructure construction, as well as provides system engineering services and temporary staffing; software and hardware maintenance, and operation; cloud; BPO; credit investigation; and digital and payment processing services. The company also offers cashless payment solutions, contact center solutions, and security and infrastructure solutions. It serves financial institutions, public organizations, retailers, and e-commerce businesses. The company was formerly known as CJK Co. Ltd. and changed its name to ITFOR Inc. in 2000. ITFOR Inc. was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

9837.d: Morito Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of apparel-related materials and household goods and products in Japan, Asia, Europe, and the United States. It provides eyelets, snap fasteners, buckles, tape, and shoe uppers, casual wear, sportswear, formal wear, and uniforms. The company also offers stationery and office automation equipment. In addition, it is involved in import, sale, and wholesale of marine and leisure equipment, snowboards, and the rental, sale, and cleaning of kitchen equipment; and transportation business. The company was formerly known as Morito & Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Morito Co., Ltd. in 1976. Morito Co., Ltd. was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

2594.d: Key Coffee Inc. engages in the coffee business in Japan and internationally. The company produces and markets coffee, food ingredients and tea products for commercial, household, raw materials; and food and beverage services at directly managed stores include providing customers with drinks, food, sweets, etc. It also operates a plantation business. In addition, the company offers home-brewed and professional-use products. Key Coffee Inc. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

1813.d: Fudo Tetra Corporation engages in the civil engineering, ground improvement, and blocks and environment businesses in Japan. The company undertakes land-based civil engineering works related to roads, railways, dams, rivers, water and sewage, and energy facilities; and marine civil engineering works such as ports, airports, fishing ports, coastlines, and artificial islands, as well as offers environmental solutions. It also provides ground improvement technologies for subsidence countermeasures, stabilization measures, liquefaction countermeasures, water stoppage measures, architectural foundations, and other technologies. In addition, the company offers 3D building block, flat, staircase shaped, upright wave-dissipating, and permanent formwork blocks; environmental landscaping products; sells aquatic environment and landscape products such as filter units and reef mats; and provides technical and design services, including the creation of cross-sectional and layout drawings using CAD, and proposals for optimal structures based on experiments and numerical simulations. Fudo Tetra Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

1930.d: Hokuriku Electrical Construction Co.,Ltd. engages in the construction business in Japan. The company is involved in electrical contracting, telecommunications, ventilating and air conditioning, plumbing, firefighting facilities, and steel structure works. It also provides businesses related to electrical, steam, and other energy. In addition, the company sells, leases, and manages real estate properties. Hokuriku Electrical Construction Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Toyama, Japan.

5989.d: H-One Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive and motorcycle parts, and dies and welding equipment in Japan, North America, Asia, and China. The company offers automobile frames, including front bulkhead, front side frame, rear frame, rear wheelhouse comp, and pillar comp, as well as door beams. It also provides motorcycle and power products, such as control levers, yoke rotors, and pushrods; and metal separators and 3DQ body frames, as well as dies and welding equipment. The company was formerly known as Hirata Technical Co., Ltd., and changed its name to H-One Co.,Ltd. in April 2006. H-One Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

6823.d: Rion Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, sells, and services particle counters, medical equipment, and environmental equipment in Japan. The company's audiological equipment includes hearing instruments, such as analog and digital BTE, trimmer digital BTE, in-the-ear ready and custom-made, and analog body aid instruments, as well as wireless and waterproof hearing instruments; and medical equipment comprising audiometers and OAE screeners. Its sound and vibration measuring instruments include sound level meters, vibration meters, seismometers, frequency analyzers, microphones and recorders, and other products. The company's particle counters comprise air and liquid-borne particle counters, and viable particle counters. Its products are primarily used in the applications of environment-related administration, electronics, semiconductors, pharmaceutical, and food manufacturing industries. The company provides commercial facility tiles, train station platforms and concourse tiles, and outdoor tiles and blocks under the Kuriyama brand; and sports flooring materials, including all-weather rubber track, elastic sports flooring sheets, and long-pile artificial turf. In addition, it offers ocean and antibacterial mats; and oil-free antibacterial and reactive dye mops; hygiene-related products and water purifiers; and aromatics and sponges products, as well as engages in real estate management business. It sells its hoses products under the Kuri Tec, tigerflex, Accuflex, PIRANHA, HOSE TEC, and ALFAGOMMA brands for use in beverage, agriculture, mining, and infrastructure industries; and its rubber and TPU hose products under the OROFLEX, ARMTEX, ARMTEX BLINDEX, and Blue Devil brand names. The company was formerly known as Kuriyama Corporation and changed its name to Kuriyama Holdings Corporation in 2012. Kuriyama Holdings Corporation was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
3355.l: 【特色】ゴム、合成樹脂製ホースを日米欧で展開。運動施設・建設用床材も。子会社で尿素ＳＣＲ事業 連結事業 【連結事業】北米51(5)、産業資材30(8)、スポーツ・建設資材12(9)、欧州・南米6(3)、他0(-7)

9319.d: Chuo Warehouse Co.,Ltd. provides various logistics services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through segments Domestic logistics business, International cargo business, Real estate rental business. The company offers warehousing, which includes storage at a constant temperature and humidity, bonded warehouse, storage units, business support, storage of dangerous goods, distribution processing, warehouse receipts, and logistics facility rental; and transportation business offers Freight forwarding, trucking, and insurance agency. It also engages in the packaging precision machinery, three-ply cardboard, and packaging materials, and customs clearance; and leasing, brokerage, management, and sale of real estate. The company was incorporated in 1927 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.
9319.l: 【特色】内陸の総合物流でトップクラス。倉庫上位の安田倉庫と連携、補完し合い国際貨物拡大に注力 連結事業 【連結事業】国内物流80(11)、国際貨物19(9)、不動産賃貸1(43)(2026.3)

7679.d: YAKUODO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in drugstore business in Japan. It retails health products, including energy drinks, cold medicine, disposable diapers for nursing care, and sanitary products; beauty products comprising skincare, cosmetics, and hair and oral care products; home products, such as detergents and household paper; and food products that include frozen food, beer, and chuhai. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Morioka, Japan.
7679.l: 【特色】独立系ドラッグストア。地盤の岩手に加えて東北他県で店舗展開。２５年から関東への出店を開始 連結事業 【連結事業】ヘルス16、ビューティー13、ホーム22、フード49(2026.2)

8018.d: Sankyo Seiko Co., Ltd. engages in the fashion, textile, and real estate businesses in Japan and internationally. The company provides various women's and men's wear, loungewear, sports, and outdoor products. It is also involved in the leasing business, building maintenance, and interior decoration work business, including rental of offices, halls, and buildings rental. In addition, the company engages in the retail, wholesale, and licensing business. It offers its products under the DAKS and LEONARD brands. It also imports/exports its branded products. Sankyo Seiko Co., Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

7409.d: AeroEdge Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells aerospace engine parts in Japan. It offers machining and additive manufacturing services; and engineering consulting services. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Ashikaga, Japan.

296A.d: Reiwa Accounting Holdings Co., Ltd. provides consulting services focused on accounting operations and business management in Japan. It provides payroll calculation, temporary staffing, recruitment, accounting, bookkeeping certification, labor management, labor consulting, and other business process outsourcing services, as well as planning and running training and seminars on accounting practices. The company also engages in the planning, design, production, development, and sales of systems related to accounting operations; the operation, maintenance, management, and updating of IT systems; and the planning, investigation, research, development, technical support, training, and consulting related to systems for management, business, information processing, and information communication. In addition, It provides consulting services related to management and finance, along with related services. The company serves various clients, including companies, students, accounting staff, and other related parties. Reiwa Accounting Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

5408.d: Nakayama Steel Works, Ltd. engages in the steel, engineering, building materials, and real estate businesses in Japan. It offers steel coil products, including hot, pickling, plated, slit, and striped /pattern coils; and steel sheet products, such as thick steel and NP steel plates, leveler sheets, and checkered steel and pattern steel plates, as well as hot rolled steel products. The company also provides bars and wire rod products comprising steel bars, burn-in- coils, and wire rods, as well as lightweight C-shaped steel products, steel pipes, steel sheets, secondary wire rod products, billets, and by-products. In addition, it offers steel fish, breeding, and seaweed reefs; and casting machine engineering products, including rolls, valves, and casting and processing equipment. Further, the company plans, designs, and constructs factories, warehouses, offices, etc. Additionally, it engages in manufacturing and processing of lightweight shaped steel products, electro sewn steel pipes, construction-related products, etc.; buying, leasing, brokerage, and sale of real estate properties; and port transportation and freight vehicle transportation businesses. The company provides general shipping and shipping brokerage services; and environmental services. The company was incorporated in 1923 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

4714.d: Riso Kyoiku Group Corporation operates TOMAS private study Juku schools for elementary, middle, and high school students in Japan. It also operates Medic TOMAS that specialize in preparation for medical school exams; Spec TOMAS that offers private tuition for school entrance test; shinmekai for elementary and kindergarten entrance exam; Shingakai that specialize in preparation for elementary school and kindergarten entrance exams; shinga's club for children's day care and entrance exam; meimonkai provides professional tutors; Meimonkai that offers professional tutoring center for working adults; TOMAIKAI provides private tuition for school advancement tests countrywide; School TOMAS offers in-house support for schools to supplement lessons and reducing stress on the workforce; Inter TOMAS provides private instruction with native and bilingual english speakers that utilisie individual curricula to prepare for TOIEC, TOEFL, and other qualifications; and plus one Kyoiku for life skills. The company was formerly known as Riso Kyoiku Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Riso Kyoiku Group Corporation in September 2025. Riso Kyoiku Group Corporation was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2831.d: Hagoromo Foods Corporation manufactures and sells various food products in Japan. The company offers tuna products, such as canned tuna and bonito; canned fruits, such as mandarin oranges, white peaches, pineapples, and yellow peaches; desserts comprising boiled azuki beans and zenzai; pasta and sauces; dried bonito flakes, seaweed, and seasonings; packaged rice; and prepared food, including canned sweet corn and pouch series of single-use ingredients, as well as a series of mackerel, saury, and sardines. It also provides fish extract, fish oil, and feed products, as well as pet food. The company was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.

9955.d: The Yonkyu Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the fishery industry in Japan. It operates through the Fresh Fish Sales Business, and Feed and animal feed sales business segments. The company engages in the sale of sea bream, yellowtail, and amberjack; artificial hatching of fish primarily red sea breams; raising, processing, and shipping of pacific bluefin tuna; and eel farming business. It also sells live feed, compound feed, mixed feed, moist pellets. In addition, the company is involved in general freight transportation, and fresh fish retail business. The Yonkyu Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Uwajima, Japan.

6648.d: Kawaden Corporation engages in the design, manufacture, installs, and sale of electrical machinery and equipment in Japan. It also designs and supervises electrical work; and sells electrical and building materials. In addition, the company offers switchboards, unit control panels, distribution boards, monitoring boards, PDU boards, WHM wiring checkers, RFC2 units, and AR-4 and CX-TX products, as well as automatic control boards. Its products are used in large and medium size office buildings, hospitals, schools, factories, large apartments, etc. The company was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4345.d: CTS Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the provision of ICT construction services for the construction industry in Japan. The company also offers cloud storage services; mobaden, a mobile fixed IP phone service for on-site offices; outdoor network construction; cloud video and recording services, as well as CTS network camera rental services; remote work support services through GENBA Connect, a communication tool based on a web conference system, as well as GENBA Connect SP, a remote work support system that enables real-time two-way communication with a cloud continuous recording type wearable camera and a viewer for viewing; printing services; and sensor information solutions. In addition, it offers 3D measurement, one-man survey, 3D design data, ICT construction, construction management, electronic delivery, and other surveying and measuring equipment, such as lasers; and inspects and repair surveying instruments. Further, the company provides office furniture, home appliances, air conditioners, and heating equipment; and rents and sells office desks, meeting tables, chairs, bookshelves, etc., as well as provides sterilization cleaning services. Additionally, it engages in the road sign construction activity; installation of guard fences; and designing and construction of emergency shelters, solar lighting, and health playground equipment. CTS Co., Ltd. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Ueda, Japan.

6485.d: Maezawa Kyuso Industries Co.,Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells water supply equipment in Japan. It operates through the Water Supply Equipment, Housing & Building Equipment, and Product Sales segments. The company produces and sells water supply equipment for city waterworks, such as products for drawing water from distribution pipes to residential and commercial premises. It also provides hot water piping components for indoor use, floor heating components, and related products, as well as plumbing equipment materials for homes and buildings. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Meguro, Japan.

3221.d: Yossix Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the restaurant business in Japan. It operates through Restaurant Business and Construction Business segments. The company also designs and constructs stores. In addition, the company engages in investment and M&A business, and food and sub-contracted catering business. The company was formerly known as Yossix Co.,Ltd. Yossix Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

6470.d: Taiho Kogyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells bearings in Japan. It offers engine parts, such as vacuum pumps, exhaust valves, turbocharger parts, engine parts top, and engine bearings; drive auxiliary bearing and compressor parts; and noise damping PCU covers, stack manifold and pressure plates, and adhesive gaskets, as well as fuel cell power generation contract testing products. The company also offers aluminum die-cast products and precision molds. Taiho Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Toyota, Japan.

9467.d: AlphaPolis Co., Ltd. engages in site management and books publishing businesses in Japan. The company publishes light novels, anime, and paperbacks, as well as other books comprising general novels, manga, and other content; and translation publications of overseas books. It also operates Alphapolis, a platform for viewing content, such as novels. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

4685.d: Ryoyu Systems Co., Ltd. provides design, development, operation and maintenance of information and communication systems for various industries in Japan. The company offers system development services for production management systems; system maintenance/operation/monitoring services, including design of information systems and communication networks; and IT infrastructure construction services comprising planning, design, construction, and operation of IT platforms, such as computers, peripherals, network devices, and communication cables. It also provides analysis solutions, including aerodynamic/structural analysis of aircraft, rockets, and engines and mechanical devices, as well as collision/impact analysis of automobiles; CAD design services; product lifecycle management system that integrates and manages various data, processes, and resources; information security operation services; and digital technologies such as AI, IoT, big data analytics, and AR. In addition, it offers outsourcing of information processing services. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

523A.d: SEIWA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells highway signs; and fabricates inspection lanes and steel brackets. The company also provides electro-galvanizing and zinc plating services for elevators and industrial machinery; designs and installs steel structures; sells various industrial machinery, etc.; and manufactures and sells electric wires and cables, generator and engine covers for ships, vacuum rubber molding machines, molding assist and bio-related equipment, and liquid level gauge and sight glass. It also engages in the painting of metal automotive parts; and plating of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and machine tool parts. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

3843.d: FreeBit Co., Ltd. operates as a supporting Internet business, and broadband business company. The company operates through the 5G Infrastructure Support Project, 5G Lifestyles Support Business, and Companies and Creators 5G DX Support Business segments. The 5G Infrastructure Support Project segment uses artificial intelligence and blockchain to provide a business platform. The 5G Lifestyles Support Business segment provides business platforms for safe and secure ways of working and housing, real estate-related services, and web-related platforms. The Companies and Creators 5G DX Support Business segment engages in building platform for maintaining relations with customers. In addition, it offers network business for internet service providers. Further, the company offers mobile virtual network enabler, mobile virtual network operator, and cloud businesses, as well as a network consulting business. FreeBit Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4847.d: Intelligent Wave Inc. provides system development services and system products in Japan and internationally. The company's technology is used primarily in online transaction processing systems for credit cards. It offers financial system solutions, including NET+1, a software product for handling online transactions over networks; ACEPlus system that detects fraudulent card payments in real time and minimizes the risk of fraudulent transactions; and EoM, an IP flow monitoring solution for broadcasting industry. The company also provides security products, such as CWAT, a multidimensional information security software platform combating information leaks and preventing critical data extrusion by centrally monitoring and controlling network and terminal operations within a company. In addition, it sells hardware products. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Intelligent Wave Inc. is a subsidiary of Dai Nippon Printing Co., Ltd.

3139.d: Lacto Japan Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, trades in agricultural and livestock products, processed products, food additives, food processing machinery, pharmaceuticals, quasi-pharmaceuticals, liquor and other beverages, and food products in Japan and internationally. The company offers whole milk powder, skimmed milk powder, butter, ice cream, whey powder, whey protein concentrate, casein, caseinate, powdered milk mixtures, prepared butter mixtures, cocoa preparations, other milk preparations, lactose, condensed milk, processed egg products, natural cheese, processed cheese, processed meat products, fresh meat, processed food, and functional food ingredients. It also provides agency and brokerage services. The company serves food manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers; and sports nutrition, and beauty and health industries. Lacto Japan Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7760.d: IMV Corporation manufactures and sells vibration simulation systems and measuring systems in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States of America, and internationally. The company offers vibration simulation systems; test and solution services; and measuring devices, such as vibration measuring and monitoring devices, earthquake monitoring devices, and environmental reliability evaluation systems. It also offers quality control services to automobiles, aerospace, defense, and electronics industries. In addition, it provides vibration controllers; rental vibration testing machine; seismometers; vibration pick-up and sensors; and insulation degradation evaluation test equipment. It also develops, produces, repairs, and maintains vibration and environmental test systems. In addition, it offers test house, measuring analysis, and other consulting services for vibration tests. Further, the company leases vibration test machine. IMV Corporation was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

9405.d: Asahi Broadcasting Group Holdings Corporation engages in television and radio broadcasting activities in Japan and internationally. The company operates in two segments: Broadcasting and Content, and Lifestyle. The company engages in television and radio broadcasting, as well as activities related to various content. It is also involved in the operation of housing exhibition sites, at-home shopping, golf club operating activities, licensing, music publishing, and international business development. The company was formerly known as Asahi Broadcasting Corporation and changed its name to Asahi Broadcasting Group Holdings Corporation in April 2018. Asahi Broadcasting Group Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

8101.d: GSI Creos Corporation offers textiles and industrial products in Japan and internationally. It offers fibers for use in materials for innerwear, legwear, stockings, tights, and socks, sweaters, and bedding; recycled and biodegradable materials; natural fibers; elastic, finished, and functional yarns; plant-derived, thermal, semi-synthetic, and cooling fiber; and women, men, and children clothing, outdoor wear, and sportswear. It also engages in production, and sale of modeling paints, tools, plastic models, and products for handcrafts; selling household items and sanitary goods; insoles; e- commerce business; supply of spatial care, antibacterial, and antiviral masks, and bathtime tops; selling health food ingredients; and selling medical devices, including dialysis machines and equipment. In addition, it engages in the handling of cosmetic raw materials derived from plants, the ocean, microalgaeas; skin and haircare raw materials; and provides nail oils as nail-related products, including nail art brushes, nail oils, files, cleaners, washers, air nail system, reed diffuser, base gel, and nail balm. Further, it develops and sells products with cutting-edge technologies; machineries used for the manufacturing of industrial products, semiconductors, and medical devices; supplies silicon wafers, ceramic materials, and quartz parts; vaporizers, wafter transfer robots, and deformation measuring devices and particle coating; and engages in import, export, and sales of various industrial components. Additionally, it offers cleaning and glass parting agents; rubber hoses; papers; self-healing paints; fluorine and fluorine materials; electrical discharge, plastic molding, composite material-related, and textile machines; ion exchange resins; filters; materials; and equipment. The company was formerly known as Gunze Sangyo, Inc. and changed its name to GSI Creos Corporation in 2001. GSI Creos Corporation was incorporated in 1931 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6469.d: Hoden Seimitsu Kako Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electric discharge machining, industrial gas turbine parts, and other metal products. The company operates through Electric discharge machining and surface treatment, Molds, Machinery, equipment, and Others. It also offers aircraft engine parts, servo press machines, fully chrome-free coating, dies and molding, and automotive parts. In addition, the company provides dies-molding, and extrusion dies for aluminum and ceramic honeycomb. Further it engages in surface treatment of aircraft engine components, gas turbine components, and automobile-related items, chromium-free coating; and creating mechatronics products, making, and manufacturing of related items, and commissioning of press composite processing system, digital servo press, and press parts. Hoden Seimitsu Kako Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

7932.d: Nippi,Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells collagen and gelatin products in Japan, Thailand, rest of Asia, North America, and internationally. It operates through Collagen Casing Business, Gelatin-Related Business, Cosmetics Related Business, Leather-Related Business, Pipes and Real Estate Business, and Food and Other Businesses segments. The company offers collagen casings for use in various fields, including sausages, other food, medicine and medical care, and cosmetics; gelatin products, which is used in food, pharmaceuticals, and photo films; collagen peptides for the food and pharmaceutical industries; leather products for the automotive industry; and collagen-based cosmetics, skin and health care, and functional food products. It also provides functional polymers comprising Nippi Linker cross-linked polyvinyl chloride (PVC) films and sheets, and cross-linked PVC compounds for electric wires and cables; and Nippi V PVC quilting cloth and foam products. In addition, the company offers pet supplements, and test regents and kits for animals; life science products, such as low endotoxin gelatin products, recombinant human laminin protein for iPS cell culture substrates, lab equipment and supplies, and reagents for research; and synthetic products, such as plastics and compounds. Further, it engages in the development of urban renewal projects; and provision of management, consulting, and real estate rental services. The company was formerly known as The Japan Leather Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippi,Incorporated in February 1974. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Adachi, Japan.

7482.d: Shimojima Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale and retail of paper products, plastic products and packaging materials, and in-store materials primarily in Japan. The company operates through three reporting segments: Paper Products, Chemicals & Packaging Materials, and Retail Supplies. It offers paper bags, wrapping paper, and paper containers; plastic bags, adhesive tapes, food packaging materials, strings and ribbons, and other packaging materials; and in-store display materials, stationery and office supplies, goods for in-store use, apparel-related materials, and horticulture-related materials. It also provides OPP bags, boxes, kitchen goods, tableware, hygiene and cleaning supplies, event supplies, and ceremonial goods. The company was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4826.d: Computer Institute of Japan, Ltd. provides system development and related services in Japan. It offers SONOBA COMET, a secure paperless meeting system that runs on tablets; Ofigo, a contract management and handling system that streamlines agreement and contract management operations; and LeGrad, a conversion tool that enables a system migration to support diverse program languages, databases, and platforms. The company also provides digital transformation, system development, maintenance, and operation, temporary staffing, IT consulting; and offshore development services. In addition, it offers system development solutions for public, communication, manufacturing, research and development, financial, and other industrial sectors. Computer Institute of Japan, Ltd. was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Yokohama, Japan.

5484.d: Tohoku Steel Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and distributes various types of special steel products in Japan. The company offers heat resistant and stainless steel materials, magnetic materials, and low thermal expansion alloys; special alloys, including ferrous and non-ferrous alloys; precision processed products, such as cold-/warm-forged NNS, torque sensor, automobile high pressure pump parts, and machined and processed composite products; heat treatment products; and automatic coercive force meters. Tohoku Steel Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1937 and is based in Shibata, Japan. As of June 29, 2026 Tohoku Steel Co., Ltd. operates as subsidiary of Daido Steel Co., Ltd.

6232.d: ACSL Ltd. manufactures industrial drones in Japan and internationally. It offers delivery, inspection, disaster relief, and emerging use-case solutions; and solution services for automation with autonomous technology. The company was formerly known as Autonomous Control Systems Laboratory Ltd. and changed its name to ACSL Ltd. in June 2021. ACSL Ltd. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Edogawa, Japan.

6844.d: Shindengen Electric Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells semiconductors, electrical equipment, and power supply products in Japan. It operates in three segments: Power Device Business, Power Unit Business, and Power Systems Business. The company offers DC quick charger, AC charger for EV, wireless charging system, engine and motor control, battery power supply, damper, power steering, and lighting control products; and energy storage systems ad inverters, electrical storage inverters, inverter units, PV inverters, monitoring systems, O&M service, and other products. It also provides industrial equipment, LED lighting, AC/DC power supplies, internet infrastructure, data centers, telecommunication power supplies, and semiconductor power. In addition, it serves the mobility, energy, industrial equipment, telecommunication, and home appliance markets. Shindengen Electric Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7774.d: Japan Tissue Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the regenerative medicine business in Japan. The company operates through Regenerative Medicine Product, Regenerative Medicine Contract, and Lab Site Project segments. It offers autologous cultured epidermis, cartilage, corneal epithelium, and oral mucosal epithelium to medical institutions for the purpose of medical treatment. The company also provides tissue-engineered medical products. In addition, it offers EPI-MODEL, a reconstructed human epidermis model. Further, the company offers regenerative medicine contract development and manufacturing services. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Gamagori, Japan. Japan Tissue Engineering Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Teijin Limited.

3193.d: Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd. operates restaurants under the Torikizoku, Yakitori Daikichi, Toriki Burger, zoku, HASU, and mozu brands in Japan and internationally. It also engages in the franchise development of the Yakitori Daikichi brand. The company was formerly known as Torikizoku Holdings Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd. in May 2024. Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

7874.d: LEC, Inc. manufactures and sells sanitizers, masks, hygiene products, baby and hand wipes, cleaning and detergent products, insecticides and insect repellents, bath cleaning, and toiletry products worldwide. It also offers toilet accessories, deodorants, toothpaste sheets, bath and washbasin, bathtubs, bathmat and chairs, towel rack, mirror, mirror care, kitchen cleaning supplies, laundry supplies and hangers, magnets, adhesives, suction cups, pins, S-hooks, floor protection, mats, and storage supplies, beauty and health products. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4763.d: CREEK & RIVER Co., Ltd. engages in the production and management of creative artists and agencies, as well as rights management in Japan and internationally. It offers company news department, company press office for recruiting, online event shooting and distribution service, and multi-channel network services; agency services; and rights management services, as well as game, web, advertising and publishing, writer, and performing arts services. The company also offers medical and healthcare; construction; and life sciences and agriculture services, as well as investment business. In addition, it provides XR (VR/AR/MR), IT consulting / AI and system development; data marketing and data utilization support; support for new business development; development and operation of media, social networking services, and platforms; promotion services; support for education and human resource development; and agency content development services. It serves fashion, healthcare, IT, law, accounting, architecture, fashion, food, and CXO industries. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

8217.d: Okuwa Co., Ltd. operates and manages stores in Japan. Its stores offer food, alcoholic beverages, rice, household goods, home furnishings, interior decoration, DIY, leisure goods, sports goods, home appliances, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and clothing products. The company also operates in online shopping business. Okuwa Co., Ltd. was founded in 1938 and is based in Wakayama, Japan.

6125.d: Okamoto Machine Tool Works, Ltd. manufactures and sells grinding machines and semiconductor-related equipment in Japan and internationally. The company operates through the Machine Tools and Semiconductor Related Equipment segments. It offers precision surface, precision form, cylindrical/internal/universal, and specialized grinding machines; semiconductor manufacturing equipment; precision gears and castings; and polishing and slicing machines. The company was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Annaka, Japan.

2114.d: Fuji Nihon Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of refined sugar and sugar-related products in Japan. It offers refined white, granulated, brown and medium brown, rock, and liquid and liquid brown sugar. The company also provides inulin, a water-soluble fiber found in vegetables for maintaining the intestine clean; and cut flower nutrients under the KEEPFLOWER brand name, as well as offers consultancy services for growers, florists, and customers. In addition, it offers food additives preparations and functional materials. The company was formerly known as Fuji Nihon Seito Corporation and changed its name to Fuji Nihon Corporation in October 2024. Fuji Nihon Corporation was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4072.d: Densan System Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides information and collection agency services in Japan. It offers solutions for data processing, systems integration, and software development, including integrated payment, payment acceptance, and settlement services, as well as information technology services. The company also provides cloud services; data entry works; digital and credit guarantee type payment services; payment processing system; computer system development, maintenance, operation, and quality inspection; information system planning, design, management, operation, and consulting; sales of computer-related equipment and peripherals; and worker dispatch business related to information processing. In addition, it is involved in the planning, development, operation, and sale of ASP systems for the oil sales industry; IT consulting; website design and construction; system design and construction; internet service management; internet information provision; import and sale of cybersecurity products; cybersecurity business consulting; and optical fiber, multimedia, data transfer systems. The company was formerly known as Densan System Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Densan System Holdings Co., Ltd. in July 2021. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Gifu, Japan.

3741.d: Systems Engineering Consultants Co.,LTD., a software development company, provides real-time software solutions in mobile networking, Internet technology, public infrastructure, space, robotics, and advanced technology fields in Japan. Its mobile networking business develops embedded software for various mobile devices, including smartphones and tablet PCs, mobile terminals, and in-vehicle information terminals; and Internet technology business develops embedded software for contactless IC cards and other application technologies, such as IoT-related technologies; and real-time technologies, including augmented reality, virtual reality, mixed reality, XML technologies, and cloud systems. The company also develops public infrastructure comprising application technologies for public infrastructure fields, including advanced transportation systems, defense-related systems, location information management systems, and systems for use in medical, environmental energy, and government offices. In addition, its space, robotics, and advanced technologies business offers embedded systems for scientific satellites, planetary probes, and data analysis systems, as well as researches and develops robots; and development and consulting services on various uses of robotic systems. Further, the company provides RTMSafety, a robot middleware; Rtino, an indoor autonomous mobile robot software; and Rtrilo, a computer vision software for robots and other machines. Systems Engineering Consultants Co.,LTD. was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

5902.d: Hokkan Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the container, filling, and machinery production, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells various types of unfilled cans, containers, tinplate processed products, and die pressing product, as well as PET plastic bottles, containers and bag-in-box, food cans, beverage cans, 18-liter cans, and decorative cans; printing/painting and painting of tin sheets; and molds and processes synthetic resins. 8881.d: NISSHIN GROUP HOLDINGS Company, Limited plans, develops, constructs, manages, and sells condominiums in Japan.
