The company also engages in the brokerage, rental brokerage, and renovation activities; real estate stock and securitization businesses; and purchase, resale, and renovation business of second-hand condominiums. In addition, it offers mortgage guarantees and housing loans to condominium buyers; plans, develops, and sells detached houses; and constructs apartment buildings. NISSHIN GROUP HOLDINGS Company, Limited was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

3825.d: Remixpoint, Inc. engages in the development and sale of energy management systems and energy-saving support consulting services in Japan. The company operates through four segments: Energy Business, Resilience Business, Financial Investment Business, and Others. It also provides electric power retail services, energy saving and subsidy support and consulting, energy management, and zero energy building services; and sells storage batteries for home use and infectious disease prevention products. Further, it provides antibacterial/antiviral coating, lighting strike suppression lighting, MA-T visualization of closed/dense, water dispenser, spatial environment improvement, AI face recognition and body temperature detection, and power supply. Additionally, the company offers services related to cryptocurrency investment, stock investment, and loans, as well as marketing consulting services. Remixpoint, Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

5845.d: Zenhoren Co.,Ltd. provides rent guarantee services to lessors of rental properties in Japan. It offers rent guarantee services for residential buildings, stores and offices, parking lots, warehouses and trunk rooms, and fire insurance and real estate companies, as well as tuition fee guarantee services for vocational schools and students through Z-College support. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Naha, Japan. As of April 3, 2025, Zenhoren Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsubishi UFJ NICOS Co.,Ltd.

5592.d: Kusurinomadoguchi, Inc. provides solutions for pharmacies and medical care in Japan. The company offers EPARK drug counter, a pharmacy/drugstore search and reservation site; matching site to buy and sell dead stock medicines at dispensing pharmacies; site for medicine counter telephone medical treatment; Care Daisy system to link recording systems and ICT devices; solution for purchasing pharmaceuticals; and system that allows for centralized management of outpatient reception, outpatient reservations, and online medical treatment. It also provides Pharmacy Support, a customer management system for repeat patients in the pharmacy industry; system specialized for dispensing pharmacies; matching service that connects nursing care facilities and pharmacies; solution from the purchase of pharmaceuticals to the purchase of immovable inventory; Online consultation by hospital support; online medication guidance; support solution to pharmacies; EPARK medicine notebook, a medication notebook that allows to make dispensing reservations and manage family medicines; and a system that allows patients to select the pharmacy they want to visit. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5363.d: TYK Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of functional refractories and ceramics worldwide. It offers converter, pig iron ladles, secondary refining, gas blowing, large precast blocks, lance pipes, blast furnace, continuous casting, cement kiln and lime kiln, incinerator and industrial furnace, and auxiliary machinery and equipment. The company also provides fine ceramics, such as alumina, magnesia, zirconia, and silicon nitride and carbide; die-cast sleeves; graphite sheet, carbon tray, and special carbon materials; and NOTORP continuous copper sensor, NOTORP-G, and NOTORP-GII devices for iron and steelmaking, cast iron/nonferrous metal, chemistry, electrical and electronic equipment, car, food processing and agriculture, gas, and medical care industries. In addition, it offers engineering services; and analysis products, including atomic absorption photometer, infrared spectrophotometer, thermal balance, particle size distribution meter, multi-specimen specific surface area/pore size distribution measuring device, carbon/sulfur analyzer, scanning electron microscope, fluorescence X-ray device, X-ray diffractometer, and thermal expansion measuring device. TYK Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

6070.d: Careerlink Co., Ltd. provides human resource services in Japan. It offers personnel services for BPO-related businesses, including dispatching of personnel to BPO businesses that are suffering from labor shortages; CRM-related services; general office work services, such as dispatching of human resources for various general administrative work and office work. Careerlink Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6327.d: Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of press machines, factory automation equipment, and transfer machines. The company offers hot laminating press related machinery used for fabrication of printed circuit boards, mobile communication, home appliances, automobiles, satellites, and resin forming applications. It also provides automatic stacking machines for carbon fiber reinforced thermoplastic laminates used in aviation and automobile industries and unidirectional continuous fiber materials; laminators for laminating solar panels, on-board solar light panels, curved glass, touch panels, decorative glass plates, etc.; and solid stockers, automated warehouse systems, floor lifts, and special machinery. The company was formerly known as Kotobuki Seisakusho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. in September 1960. Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

2209.d: Imuraya Group Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of various food products in Japan and internationally. It offers confectionary, including bean jellies, and pancakes; processed food, such as bean paste, sweet porridge, shaved ice syrup, and sticky steamed rice; steamed bun with meat fillings and sweetened bean fillings; ice creams; tofu and refrigerated products; frozen sweets; and powdered seasoning products. The company also operates an American style restaurant under the Anna Miller's name; and South France Provence Patisserie under the La maison JOUVAUD name. In addition, the company is involved in managing leasing agency; real-estate leasing; and provision of property management. The company was formerly known as Imuraya Confectionery Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Imuraya Group Co., Ltd. in October 2010. The company was founded in 1896 and is based in Tsu, Japan.

3315.d: Nippon Coke & Engineering Company, Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of coke worldwide. The company is also involved in the sale of coal and petroleum coke; production and sale of chemical equipment and devices; and resource recycling, logistics, and real estate activities. Nippon Coke & Engineering Company, Limited was formerly known as Mitsui Mining Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Coke & Engineering Company, Limited in April 2009. The company was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7047.d: Port Inc. operates various domain-specific vertical media and develops content marketing for user needs in Japan. The company provides Career Park, a career information platform for job hunting for students and adults; Career park! Employment agent that provides matching services between job hunters and companies; The Future of job hunting, an information site that provides job hunting know-how; cutlet, an event information site for job hunting students; and Job hunting meetings, a site that provides real word of mouth information for job hunting students. The company also operates Manet, an information site for borrowing, saving, and increasing money lives of users; Manet (card loan), a card information loan site; and Manet (FX), a site that provides information related to FX to users. In addition, it operates Card loan agent, an information site that provides know-how information on card loans; Energy Choice, a matching site for users and electric power companies to review electricity and gas bills; Moving procedure.com, an electricity and gas procedure support site for moving destinations; Port Medical, a medical care platform; and Telemedies BP, a medical care platform that provides online medical services for hypertension. The company was formerly known as Social Recruiting Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Port Inc. in March 2015. Port Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4229.d: Gun Ei Chemical Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells synthetic resins and fibers in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Chemicals Business, Food Business, Real Estate Utilization Business. The company offers Resitop for photoresists, epoxy curing agent, maleimide curing agent, liquid type Resitop, and high purity bisphenol F; casting iron and aluminum casts; automobiles and construction machines; molding materials, papermaking, coated abrasive, resinoid grinding stone, carbon insulating materials, spherical carbon, air filter, oil filter, scoring pad, high-performance fiber, carbon fiber, and Kynol activated carbon fiber products; and heat insulating material Resitop for glass wool/rock wool. In addition, the company provides food, such as starches and sugars; and business outsourcing and staffing services. Further, it is involved in the leasing of real estate. Further, the company offers Milex, a phenolic resin for brake pads that improves braking through a chemical reaction based on a unique technology. Gun Ei Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Takasaki, Japan.

2217.d: Morozoff Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells confectionery products in Japan. It operates through Confectionery Manufacturing and Sales; and Cafe and Restaurant Management divisions. The company offers chocolates, cookies, cheesecakes, puddings and jellies, cakes, summer desserts, baked goods, frozen sweets, and summer gift sets. It also operates coffee shops. The company sells its products through directly managed stores, mall stores, station building stores, department stores, and its online shop. The company was formerly known as Morozoff Seika Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Morozoff Limited in August 1972. Morozoff Limited was incorporated in 1931 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

7525.d: Rix Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of machinery and equipment, measuring instruments, and consumables for steel, automobiles, electronics, semiconductors, rubber and tires, machine tools, environment, pulp and paper, ship building, medicine, high-function materials, and food industries in Japan. It provides rotary; rocky insulator; Nitte lights; lubricants under FRICTTLE name; hardlock nuts, bearing nuts, and set screw; and oil seals, O-rings, iron rubbers, mechanical seals, welded bellows, flexible circuits, etc. It also offers Auto Flush, a system that reduces leakage; oil skimmers; and vivid screen. In addition, the company engages in the construction, manufacturing, and sale of pipes and steel structures, as well as bearing regeneration, new bearing and part manufacturing, precision grinding, polishing, universal joint repair, and related equipment sales; manufacture, sale, and maintenance of automobile parts cleaning equipment and other industrial machinery; import and sale of anti-rust agents, moisture inhibitors, and adhesives; and coolant automatic dilution device manufacturing, electrical and control software design, control panel manufacturing and wiring work, and robot control. Further, it provides phenolic resin molded products; FRP corrosion-resistant pumps, fans, dampers, strainers, and scrubbers; washing machines for automobile parts and semiconductor; and jigs and tools, FPD manufacturing equipment, electronic and optical component manufacturing equipment, consumable parts, dry vacuum pumps, air compressors, valves for tire curing presses, tire manufacturing equipment, and hydraulic equipment. Additionally, the company is involved in the sale and repair of vacuum equipment; maintenance and management services for semiconductor manufacturing equipment; and design, manufacture, assembly, and maintenance of processed products and overhaul of machine tools. Rix Corporation was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

3915.d: TerraSky Co.,Ltd. provides cloud products and solutions in Japan and internationally. The company offers cloud integration services comprising Salesforce, AI agent implementation support, MuleSoft Anypoint, Amazon Web services, Heroku, contact center, SAP migration, B2B commerce, and financial services cloud and marketing cloud solutions, as well as solutions for manufacturing industries. It also provides cloud consulting services comprising digital marketing support, DX promotion consulting, AppExchange consulting, marketing tool implementation support service, production support solutions, and data utilization support service; development support tools, such as mitoco X, flosum, ACCELQ, DCSpider, skyvisual editor, and Elements.cloud services; and cloud services, including mitoco ERP, mitoco, Mitoco accounting, mitoco Work, mitoco AI, Fujitsu GLOVIA OM, Soask for subscription management, CloudSign for Salesforce, Salesforce Field Service, Insurance Agency Solution for insurance agents, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, OMLINE-I, OMLINE-O, ChoiceRESERVE Reservation Integration, SVF Cloud for Salesforce, MotionBoard Cloud for Salesforce, and invoiceAgent for to digitizing paper documents. The company was formerly known as Head Solutions Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Terasakai Co.,Ltd. in February 2007. TerraSky Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6584.d: Sanoh Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive parts worldwide. The company offers automotive tubing products, such as cluster tubes; and plastic fuel tubes comprising engine jumpers, fuel tank jumpers, ORVR tubes, in-tank tubes, breather tubes, vapor return tubes, canister drain tubes, ventilation tubes, and fuel filler necks. Its automotive tubing products also include brake tubes; brake vacuum tubes; metal tubing products comprising brazed and welded steel tubing products; surface treatment products, which consists of PA, PC, and PVdF coating products; plastic tubing products, such as mono-layer, multi-layer, and convoluted tubing products; and quick connectors. In addition, the company offers powertrain products, including fuel injection rails (FIRs), high-pressure FIRs, intake pipes, and fuel senders for motorcycles; and water and oil cooler pipes. Further, it provides environment and safety products consisting of exhaust gas recirculation pipes, air shutter guides, pre tensioner tubes, and seat belt buckles and shoulder adapters. The company was formerly known as Omiya Kohku Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sanoh Industrial Co., Ltd. in March 1952. Sanoh Industrial Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7628.d: Ohashi Technica Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells automotive parts and other components in Japan, the United States, China, Thailand, ASEAN, Europe, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers automotive parts comprising engine and mission, differential, brake, body and chasse, and interior/exterior components; and information technology (IT) and communications device parts, including mobile phone hinges and other IT and communications parts. It also provides precision oil pump shafts used in dual clutch transmission; and piezo injector components for diesel engines. In addition, the company plans, develops, produces, and markets precision components assembled to various products in automobile and other industries, as well as engages in procurement, export, and logistics businesses. It serves auto and auto part unit equipment manufacturers. The company was formerly known as Ohashi Shoji, Inc. and changed its name to Ohashi Technica Inc. in May 1987. Ohashi Technica Inc. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

2359.d: Core Corporation provides information and communication technology services in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Future Society Solutions Business, Industrial Technology Solutions Business, and Customer Business Integration Business. The Future Society Solutions Business segment engages in social issues such as the environment and life infrastructure. The Industrial Technology Solutions Business provides customers' business problems using IoT (AI), GNSS, and other technologies; and provides solutions that utilize ICT technology. The Customer Business Integration Business segment provides total ICT solutions that utilize business knowledge and know-how for customer business. The company offers solutions to public, medical system, energy, Internet of things, social media, space technology, Business transformation, cloud service, security measures, manufacturing, and financial operations. Core Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6061.d: UNIVERSAL ENGEISHA Co., Ltd. engages in the rental of plants and flowers in Japan. It rents plants for various venues, such as offices, hotels, restaurants, commercial spaces, showrooms, etc.; rents artificial flower arrangements; and provides landscape, gardening, and plant maintenance services. The company also offers greenery and flower gifts; artificial trees; greenery systems, such as rooftop gardening, planted wall murals, etc.; event decoration; flower arrangements; and garden flowerbeds and planters. In addition, it provides LED lights and illumination displays; rents photos and aquariums, as well as various cleaning products, such as entrance mats, mops, cleaning cloths, air cleaners, futon cleaning, etc.; and operates an online shop that offers various goods to corporate and individual assessors. Further, the company provides floral arrangements for wedding; and sells plants, flowers, containers, soils, fertilizers, gardening goods, fresh vegetables, breads, and other products, as well as pebbles, stones, and garden furniture products through garden centers. Additionally, it operates Ricoche+, a garden center for greeneries shopping; flower shop under the Fleur Universelle name; and garden-style café under the Les Grands Arbres brand name, which offers fresh meals. UNIVERSAL ENGEISHA Co., Ltd. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Ibaraki, Japan.

7238.d: Akebono Brake Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells brakes for automobiles, industrial machinery, and railway vehicles in Japan, the United States, China, Thailand, Europe, Indonesia, and internationally. The company offers disc brake calipers, disc brake pads, drum brake linings and shoes, wheel cylinders, drum-in-hat brakes, brake drums, sensors, master cylinders, brake linings, and clutch facings. Its products are used for automobiles, motorcycles, rolling stocks, and industrial machinery. The company was formerly known as Akebono Sekimen Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Akebono Brake Industry Co., Ltd. in 1960. Akebono Brake Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

9268.d: Optimus Group Company Limited offers integrated automotive services. The company operates in five segments: Import/Export, Logistics, Services, Inspection, and Retail and Wholesale. The Import/Export segment purchases used cars from auto auction operators and sells them to local car dealers internationally. The Logistics segment is involved in the ocean transport for the export of used cars from Japan and land transport of new cars to Australia. The Services segment provides services for businesses, such as used car dealers in New Zealand, as well as for general consumers. The Inspection segment conducts pre-shipment inspections, including safety checks and quarantine inspections for soil, animals, plants, and insects. The Retails and Whole segment engages in the retail and sale of new and used automobiles. It also offers automotive data and financial solutions, as well as car loans; quarantine and customs clearance; and after-sales and maintenance services. Optimus Group Company Limited was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

6653.d: Seiko Electric Co., Ltd. operates in the field of power system, and environmental energy and control system in Japan. It offers power system business unit, environmental energy control business unit, environmental energy and control systems business unit, power electronics unit, IT system solution business unit, electronic control devices unit, liquid crystal film for optical shutter, and service and engineering business unit. The company also offers power receiving, transforming, and monitoring/control systems for water and sewage facilities, lighting control systems for expressways, energy storage systems, battery power conditioners, and solutions for renewable energy and AI data centers; cloud services (SaaS) for ports, healthcare, and e-learning, as well as business support systems utilizing artificial intelligence and IoT; sales of digitalization and decarbonization products, including electrical machinery, energy-saving equipment, and robots, along with engineering, construction, and maintenance services; and control equipment, electronic devices, light control films, electrical work, and machinery installation services. The company serves central and various government offices; electric, gas, and environmental plant companies; automobile, ship building, iron, steel, nonferrous metal, electrical machinery plants; science, chemical, food products, and paper manufacturing companies; and construction companies. The company was formerly known as Seiko Shokai and changed its name to Seiko Electric Co., Ltd. in 1960. Seiko Electric Co., Ltd. was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

5210.d: Nihon Yamamura Glass Co., Ltd. produces and sells glass bottles and plastic caps in Japan and internationally. the company operates through glass bottle, plastic, new glass and logistics segments. It also offers Sintering additive and general glass powder; glaze/overcoat glass; high heat resistance crystalized glass; and LTCC materials. In addition, the company manufactures and sells glass bottle forming machines; and warehousing and logistic services. The company was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

6862.d: MINATO HOLDINGS INC. engages in the memory modules, ROM writing services, device programming, telework solutions, and digital-related equipment businesses in Japan and internationally. It is involved in the design, manufacture, and sale of dual inline memory modules, which are computer memory modules for industrial equipment; sale, maintenance, and distribution of video, audio, and cloud conferencing systems and related equipment; operation of ROM writing centers; supply of device programmer equipment and auto handlers programming systems; and provision of medium and large touch panels, as well as digital signages. The company also engages in the development of websites. Business systems, applications, and sales promotions; web production, graphic design, video production, and web promotion, including event production and planning; and investment in digital-related fields. In addition, it offers system construction services; development services comprising software and hardware specifications design, mass production, image and audio processing system. The company was formerly known as Minato Electronics Inc. and changed its name to MINATO HOLDINGS INC. in July 2015. MINATO HOLDINGS INC. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

8537.d: The Taiko Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Japan. It offers savings and internet-only deposit accounts; time deposit/regular savings; investment trusts; foreign currency deposits; public debts; financial product intermediary; automated asset management services; pension and endowment, whole life, long-term care, fire, and web-only insurance, as well as medical, cancer, dementia, income protection, and savings-type accident insurance; defined contribution pension plan; will trusts and estate settlement services; and inheritance procedure support services. The company also provides card, personal, car, educational, home renovation, business, reverse mortgage, and other loans; debit, credit, and cash cards; electronic money top-up and payment services; money transfer; tax payment; e-banking; internet investment trusts; ATM; pension payment; safe deposit box; point services; foreign currency delivery; web and pay-easy account transfer acceptance; international money transfer; and mail order services. In addition, it offers business support services, including SDGs support, advance, business matching and trade show, management consulting, subsidies and grants, recruitment, foreign exchange and overseas expansion support, and business self-assessment system services; industry-specific loan products; donation-type private placement bonds; office e-banking; NB center internet payment collection; electronic bill; farm banking; business succession support; and merger and acquisition related services. The company was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Nagaoka, Japan.

4165.d: PLAID,Inc. develops and operates KARTE, a customer experience (CX) SaaS platform in Japan. It provides KARTE CX platform, which provides real-time analytics for on-site personalization, multi-channel campaigns, and targeted ad delivery; PLAID ALPHA, which delivers data-driven strategic planning and implementation; STUDIO ZERO, a strategic planning and business development service; EmotionTechCX, a survey and analysis service for customer loyalty and CX; and EmotionTechEX, a survey and analysis service for employee engagement and organizational transformation. The company also offers TopicScan, a text AI analysis service that detects issues and signs from customer feedback and free-text descriptions; Marumy, a store management system; and Databeat, an ad automation tool. In addition, it provides business results-driven ad operations and marketing solutions. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

3393.d: Startia Holdings,Inc. engages in the IT business in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: IT Infrastructure-Related Business, DX Solution-Related Business, and CVC-Related Business. The company offers digital marketing SaaS products and services comprising marketing automation tools, application creation software, web production and content management system, other digital marketing tools, AR creation software, and document management and e-book creation software that focuses on small and medium-sized enterprise markets. It also provides IT infrastructure products and services, including total support service, copier / multifunction machines, business phone, network construction/maintenance, electricity, optical line / provider, website production / promotion, cloud construction/maintenance, office design, flat-rate printer, office relocation, security camera, commercial air conditioner, LED, air cleaner, and electronic breaker to medium-sized companies. In addition, the company offers indirect operations, such as accounting management, and support operations comprising formulation of investment plans for funds and human resources, as well as engaging in discovering, executing, and counting management, and investment projects primarily in Southeast Asia. Startia Holdings,Inc. was formerly known as Startia, Inc. and changed its name to Startia Holdings,Inc. in April 2018. Startia Holdings,Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

7952.d: Kawai Musical Instruments Manufacturing Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells musical instruments in China, Japan, North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Musical Instrument Education; Material Processing; and Others segments. It offers grand, upright, digital, and hybrid pianos; acoustics; and accessories. The company also operates music and gymnastics schools; engages in publishing business in the field of music and art; and learning centers. In addition, it develops and sells computer music software, as well as software for small businesses; manufactures and sells precision metals, interior wooden panels products, and electronic devices; provides soundproof rooms; provides physical education equipment; and promotes music appreciation through lectures and concerts. Further, it engages in information and financial related business; and operates as insurance agency. The company was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Hamamatsu, Japan.

5254.d: Arent Inc. develops SaaS based solutions for construction industry in Japan. It offers Lightning BIM software for architecture and structure industry; PlantStream software for plant/piping and plants/process applications; PROCOLLA, a cloud-based progress management system; BizGenie, a generative AI platform, PlantStream Aide, a plant piping design; BUILD, a structural design; Genba Navi Progress Management, a process management, Genba Navi 3D Rebar, a reinforcement design; Shinsekai-kun F Series, an administrative registration; Dot Genka Series, a cost management system; Tsukaeru Cloud Construction Ledger; Tsukaeru Cloud Work Attendance Management; and Let's Cost Management Go2 Series. It also provides consulting and system development services. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

5185.d: Fukoku Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells rubber, metal and synthetic resin, and bio and medical related products in Japan, Southeast Asia, India, the United States, Europe, China, South Korea, and internationally. It operates through the Functional Products Business, Anti-Vibration Business, Life Sciences Business, Metal Processing Business, and Hose Business segments. The company offers wiper blade rubbers that are used in automobiles, railways, ships, and aircrafts; and seal products, which are used in automobiles, pneumatic devices, and industrial machinery. It also provides anti-vibration products comprising suspensions, rotating systems, and engine accessories for automobiles; shock absorbers and railroad track pads for railcars; and construction and industrial machinery. In addition, the company offers standard, semi-custom, and nonmagnetic ultrasonic motors; and ultrasonic atomizer products. Further, the company provides cell culture bag products; OA-related products, such as digital photo printer rollers and pads, and ink jet printer components; urethane products and microchannel chips; dampers, mounts, and urethane; metal parts for trucks and construction machinery; and hoses and other rubber products. The company was formerly known as Fukoku Rubber Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Fukoku Co.,Ltd. in January 1986. Fukoku Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

3877.d: Chuetsu Pulp & Paper Co., Ltd. produces, processes, and sells paper, pulp, and related by-products in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments: Paper and Pulp Manufacturing Business and Power Generation Business segments. The company offers printing, information, wrapping, processing, base, specialty, and bamboo papers, as well as newspapers and paper bags, paper tubes, cardboards, and paperboards. The company is also involved in the forestry, lumbering, and timber processing activities; manufacture, processing, and trading of chemicals; selling, management, brokerage, and rental of real estate properties; management of sports facilities; and mining, warehousing, and transportation activities, as well as electricity supply activities. In addition, the company engages in the trading and greening business construction; supply of raw materials; designs mechanical equipment; paper cutting, sorting, and packaging products; manufactures and sells cellulose and nanofiber related products, wood chips, pulp, and Mapuka related products; construction repair; insurance agency; and afforestation and greening businesses. Chuetsu Pulp & Paper Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6850.d: Chino Corporation manufactures and sells instrumentation and control equipment in Japan, China, Korea, Taiwan, the United States, Germany, Italy, and internationally. The company operates through Measurement & Control Instruments, Instrumentation Systems, and Sensor segments. Its products include temperature sensors, infrared radiation thermometers, temperature calibration equipment, traceability equipment, temperature and humidity meters and sensors, constituent/moisture/thickness meters, data loggers, controllers, indicators, recorders, thyristor regulators, fuel cell testing systems, compressor performance testing systems, and instrumentation components, as well as thermal image systems. In addition, the company offers repair and maintenance services. The company was formerly known as CHINO Works, Ltd. and changed its name to Chino Corporation in 1986. Chino Corporation was founded in 1913 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

6535.d: i-mobile Co.,Ltd. engages in the Internet advertising business in Japan. It operates through Consumer Business and Internet Advertising Business segments. The company operates FuruNavi, a hometown tax donation website for local governments; offers Furunavi Travel, which allows people to earn points according to the amount of their hometown tax donations; Furunavi Gourmet Points, which uses points to visit restaurants; pay-per-click services; marketing platform, which connects companies and influencers. It is also involved in the point service business; agency business; media solutions business; and application management business. i-mobile Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

8006.d: Yuasa Funashoku Co., Ltd. operates as a food trading company in Japan. The company operates through three segments Commercial Segment, Hotel Segment, Real Estate Unit. The Commercial Segment sells food, ingredients, alcoholic beverages. The Hotel Segment operates business hotels, restaurants. The Real Estate Unit is engaged in the rental business of real estate. It also offers processed foods, chilled foods, commercial products, feed, livestock, rice, etc. The company was founded in 1936 and is headquartered in Funabashi, Japan.

6706.d: DKK Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of telecommunication and radio frequency equipment in Japan and internationally. The company's telecommunication equipment include mobile communication systems comprising cellular base station antennas, wireless equipment, small antennas, peripheral devices, and mobile communication towers, as well as provides cellular base station construction and maintenance services; and broadcasting products, such as broadcasting and microwave antennas, medium and short wave antennas, steel towers, shelters, power supply apparatus, and FPU rotators, as well as provides broadcasting construction and maintenance services. It also offers digital disaster prevention administrative radio/fire and emergency digital radio, multi-channel access, micro line antenna, and satellite communication products; high-altitude monitoring cameras, tsunami evacuation towers, disaster prevention information network systems, and telescopic columns, as well as maintenance services; CATV construction and telescopic masts; LED aviation obstacle lights, wind power towers, marine beacon, and fuel cells; and engages in volcano, fire detection, tsunami, river, and high-altitude monitoring systems; and defense related business, as well as thermal camera and software lineups, and AI automatic detection system. In addition, the company provides induction heating; high frequency oscillators; IoT technology and waveform monitor equipment; heating coils; RF applied equipment; and vacuum furnace. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7570.d: Hashimoto Sogyo Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the processing, manufacture, and sale of plumbing and housing equipment in Japan. The company is involved in the sale, development, management, and maintenance of office computer products and software; worker dispatch business; management consulting business; planning and guidance for obtaining various qualifications; and rental and management of real estate. It also engages in the travel, medical, and sports related businesses. Hashimoto Sogyo Holdings Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Hashimoto Sogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hashimoto Sogyo Holdings Co.,Ltd. in April 2016. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3916.d: Digital Information Technologies Corporation operates as an information services company. The company focuses on custom development for end-users and information systems in a wide range of fields, including finance, medical/pharmaceutical, communications, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, and public works. Its products include WebARGUS, a website security solution; xoBlos, a platform for Excel, which automates inefficient Excel-based tasks; Anti Phishing Mail Gateway, an electronic signature gateway solution automatically converts regular email to electronic signature email, as well as counters the phishing emails; shield cms, a website creation platform; Phants, a pharmacy chain management system; and DD-CONNECT, an outsourcing service for electronic contracts. The company also develops custom software for in-vehicle devices, mobile devices, information home appliances, and communication equipment; and offers verification services, including various laboratory tests. In addition. It sells Data Migration Box, a cloud migration tool; DiskDeleter, a proprietary USB memory-type data-deletion software. It sells its products to car shops, home improvement centers, tire shops, auto repair shops, and car dealers. The company was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan. In addition, it undertakes assembly and processing of electronic equipment; develops, manufactures, and sells do-it-yourself products, aluminium mold, electronic devices, printed and multi-layer printed wiring boards, metal and related products, and health care and beauty equipment; and develops and manages real estate properties. The Rental Business segment engages in the rental and sales of dust control products, nursing care products, and welfare equipment, as well as pest control devices, regular cleaning services, and restoration work. 8301.d: Bank of Japan operates as the central bank in Japan. It also offers foreign exchange transactions, including those executed as part of the bank's management of its foreign currency assets, as well as business related to assisting other central banks and international organizations in their investment in yen; and handling government affairs that relate to international finance, such as the compilation and dissemination of Japan's balance of payments statistics and foreign exchange intervention. It sells its products through physical and online stores under the A.P.C., A.P.C. golf, CLAUS PORTO, IL BISONTE, IL BISONTE JEWELRY, IL BISONTE UOMO, KEITH, Marimekko, Repetto, SCAPA, and SMYTHSON brands. The company was formerly known as Look Incorporated and changed its name to Look Holdings Incorporated in January 2018. Look Holdings Incorporated was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

7725.d: Inter Action Corporation engages in the development, manufacturing, and sells inspection illuminators for applications in imaging semiconductor manufacturing processes in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Internet of Things Related Business; Environmental Energy Related Business; and Promotion Business of Industry 4.0. It offers image sensor inspection light source devices and pupil lens modules for manufacturing CCD and CMOS image sensors. The company also manufactures, sells, and maintains drying deodorizers for rotary printing presses in mass printing applications; and exhaust gas treatment systems for factories. In addition, it provides precision vibration isolation systems that protect precision equipment; and gear testing systems to gear manufacturers. Inter Action Corporation was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

9059.d: Kanda Holdings Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates as a logistics company in Japan and internationally. It engages in the general motor truck transportation, special loading motor truck transportation, light and special motor truck transportation, consigned freight forwarding, and packaging and storage businesses. The company also provides automobile maintenance, security, warehousing, information provision service and consulting, financial leasing, custom brokerage, port and maritime transportation, and proxy driving services. In addition, it is involved in the rental, brokerage, consulting, management, and sale of real estate properties; casualty and life insurance agency businesses; industrial waste collection, transportation, and disposal activities; vehicle operation control, inspection, and maintenance contract works; and contract development, systems consulting, sales, leasing, rental, and brokerage of software and related devices. Further, the company manages dispensing pharmacies, restaurants, and parking lots; generates and sells electricity; and manufactures, sells, imports, and exports automobiles, computers, communication devices, clothing, convenience goods, food products, pharmaceuticals and quasi-drugs, cosmetics, medical equipment, medical consumables, industrial chemicals, pesticides, fuel, air conditioners, kitchen equipment, and sanitary ware products. Additionally, it engages in the civil engineering planning and designing, implementation, and supervision business, as well as decoration and cleaning of structure and additional services. The company was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

438A.d: Infcurion, Inc. develops a finance platform for all payment needs. The company provides payment infrastructure that enables digital wallets, issues international brand cards, and integrates with bank APIs. It also offers consulting services for business development. Infcurion, Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

3853.d: Asteria Corporation develops and sells software in Japan. The company offers ASTERIA Warp, a digital linkage tool for the automation of operations; Handbook X, a digital organization app; Platio, a mobile app creation tool for the creation of business apps; Gravio, an integrated edge platform for no-code AI and IoT; Artefacts, a continuous integration platform for robotic application development; SnapCal, which provides integration for Google calendar, tasks, and iOS calendar; and lino, a sticky and canvas service. It also provides product support, consulting, and training services. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

9782.d: DMS Inc. engages in direct mail service business in Japan. It offers direct marketing services, including planning and production, direct mail target optimization, mailing, personalized direct mail, and delivery services; web marketing services, such as Website and mobile site development; and logistics services, which includes shipping service for E-commerce and mail order businesses, gift campaign logistics services, and logistics for sales promotion support. The company also provides back-office support services, such as call center, data entry, telephone communication services, and other back-office solutions. In addition, it offers sales promotion solutions comprising POP display, poster, and vertical banner advertisement creation; promotional item creation; flyer delivery services; sample product delivery services; and niche media covering enclosed advertisements, etc. Further, the company is involved in planning, producing, creating, and managing sales promotion, sports and cultural, and campus events, as well as leasing services. It also designs planning, performance, production and operations for sporting events, local government projects, exhibitions, fireworks shows, ceremonies and contests, and school events. DMS Inc. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3712.d: Information Planning CO., LTD. provides system consulting services primarily for financial institutions in Japan. The company offers credit risk solutions, including comprehensive financial statement reading, financial analysis and loan decision support, real estate collateral evaluation management, corporate rating, sole proprietor rating, delinquent management system, self-assessment support, credit risk qualification and asset calculation systems, as well as bad debt record rate calculation and receivable write-off reserve management systems. It also provides loan-related and customer management solutions, such as loan approval support, contract create support, electronic contract, business evaluation support, management plan formulation support, sale support, sales branch support, and general approval support systems; and general affairs and accounting related solutions comprising fixed asset, accounting support, securities, capital investment, and expense payment administrative support management systems. In addition, the company engages in the real estate leasing and management activities; and provision of development, planning, and system data entry services. Information Planning CO., LTD. was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

9537.d: Hokuriku Gas Co.,Ltd. operates gas business in Japan. The company produces, sells, and supplies gas to customers in Niigata, Nagaoka, Sanjo, Mitsuke, Ojiya, Kashiwazaki, and Kamo cities, as well as in Tagami town and Kariwa village. It also undertakes gas construction contracts; and sells gas appliances. The company was incorporated in 1913 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.

6928.d: Enomoto Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells semiconductor and electronic components in Japan, China, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia, and internationally. The company offers lead frames for light emitting diodes products, power semiconductors, and optoelectronics, as well as connector parts and components. It also designs, develops, manufactures, and sells various precision molds, automatic mechanical equipment, medical devices, mechanical and automotive-related components, and other related products; and leases real estate properties. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Uenohara, Japan.

4538.d: Fuso Pharmaceutical Industries,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals and medical equipment in Japan. The company offers injectable drugs and dialysis agents for artificial kidneys, as well as medical drugs and equipment. It also engages in the contract manufacturing of drugs; and real estate leasing businesses. The company was incorporated in 1937 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

2477.d: Temairazu, Inc. engages in the development, operation, and provision of comparison website in Japan. It offers TEMAIRAZU, an online system that allows customers to centrally manage various accommodation reservation sites; Compare.com, offers products and services in a wide range of fields, including shopping, providers, travel, and asset management; and Hikaku.com, a site that compares the prices of various e-commerce sites. Temairazu, Inc. was formerly known as Hikaku.com Corporation and changed its name to Temairazu, Inc. in October 2017. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

3547.d: Unisia Holdings Co. engages in the restaurant management activities in Japan. It operates through House meal business; Interior construction business; and Domestic and other segments. The company engages in operating a restaurant under the Kushikatsu Tanaka brand name; a store for chicken and eggs under the Toridama name; a restaurant specializing in grilled meat with sauce and wrapped vegetables under the Yakiniku Kuruton name; provides hospitality under Kyoto Yakiniku Kuruton and Kyoto Tempura Tenno Meshi brands; and Japanese comfort food restaurant under Tanaka brand name. It also engages in restaurant management and franchise development, business app, and system development and management; store planning, design, construction, and maintenance; web design and advertising, graphic design, and SNS management. The company was formerly known as Kushikatsu Tanaka Holdings Co. and changed its name to Unisia Holdings Co. in March 2026. Unisia Holdings Co. was founded in 1998 and is based in Shinagawa, Japan.

6798.d: SMK Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of components for telecommunications and electronic equipment in Japan, Asia, North America, and Europe. It operates through Connection Systems Division, Sensing, Communication & Interface Division, and Innovation Center segments. The company offers connectors, including board to board, board to wire, FPC/FFC, RF coaxial, interface, battery, and power, as well as earth terminals, connectors for photovoltaic modules, terminals, and camera module sockets; and DC power supply plugs/jacks and mini jacks. It also provides switches, such as push, slide, multi-functional device, and detection switches; and remote controls units. The company's products are used in various applications comprising mobility, healthcare, smart home, mobile and wearable, industry and energy, and others. In addition, it engages in development and sale of voice analysis technology and electromyography sensors. The company was formerly known as Showa Musen Kogyo Kabushikigaisha and changed its name to SMK Corporation in 1985. SMK Corporation was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

2998.d: CREAL Inc. operates an asset management platform in Japan. It operates CREAL, a real estate fund online market; CREAL PB, an asset management service platform for individuals; and CREAL Pro, a platform that provides real estate investment management services to institutional investors and high-net-worth investors. The company also provides real estate crowdfunding platform and rental management services. CREAL Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2378.d: Renaissance,Incorporated engages in sports club business in Japan. It operates fitness clubs, swimming schools, tennis schools, golf schools, and other sports clubs. The company also provides health promotional services for local municipalities; nursing care and rehabilitation support services; and store development support services. In addition, it develops and promotes Synapsology, a brain activation method. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7643.d: Daiichi Co.,Ltd. operates supermarkets for foodstuffs in Japan. It is also involved in the rental of real estate properties. 6912.d: Kikusui Holdings Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of electrical measuring instruments in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the research and development, sales, and repair of electrical measuring instruments and power supply equipment; and logistics operations, product assembly, wiring, and other manufacturing operations, as well as import and export businesses. Kikusui Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

It also offers daily goods industry, housing industry, data pool, printing industry, sales support, data management, business agreement, order system, product planning and development, and complaint information management solutions. In addition, the company develops middleware solutions. eBase Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

The company operates OpenWork, a one-stop job and recruitment information platform incorporating company reviews and salary information; OpenWork Recruiting, a direct scouting service; and Job Satisfaction LAB, which publishes various job- and recruitment-related reports, as well as offers analysis and reporting services to support companies' management and organizational development. It also provides alternative data services on Japanese companies. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. OpenWork Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Link and Motivation Inc.

Kobe Electric Railway Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1926 and is based in Kobe, Japan.

6440.d: Juki Corporation manufactures and sells industrial and household sewing machines, and industrial equipment in Japan, China, India, rest of Asia, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. It offers industrial sewing machines for sewing apparel products, underwear, sportswear, shoes, bags, indoor furniture, daily commodities, car interior components, and hobby and amusement items; household sewing machines, professional sewing machines, and compact overlock sewing machines; and surface mounting technology (SMT) related equipment that are used primarily to mount electronic components, such as IC chips, semiconductors, and capacitors on electronic circuit boards. The company is also involved in the contract development and manufacturing business; and provides automated warehouse solutions. In addition, it provides smart solutions for sewing factories and circuit boards manufacturing factories. Juki Corporation was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Tama, Japan.

3242.d: Urbanet Corporation Co.,Ltd. engages in the development and sale of real estate properties in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Real Estate Business and Hotel Business. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Its control/shut-off valves include self operated type regulating, auxiliary power operated type control, remotely operated, cylinder, and safety valves, as well as pneumatic operated automatic controllers, pneumatic operated actuators, and nuclear power plant valves; and butterfly valves comprise manually operated, remote-control, and cryogenic type butterfly valves. The company also engages in the installation of pressure reducing and desuperheater other automatic control valves, and equipment. In addition, it offers valve remote control systems for cargo and ballast line and level gauging systems; and various systems for ship engines, such as fuel oil heating, fresh water cooling, and lubricating oil cooling systems; and automatic control valves for use in gas turbine power plants. Nakakita Seisakusho Co., Ltd. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Daito, Japan.

It offers Andon, digital picking, AGV, HAISHIN, barcode / RF-ID, smart card, automated storage, transport control, inventory management, embedded, and digital picking POKAYOKE systems; IIoT, O.E.E., digital ANDON, web camera monitoring, and kantan IoT systems; traceability systems comprising laser marking, QR code, and mobile / tablet; and virtualization and location information systems. The company also provides advanced control, recipe management, and start-up/shut-down emergency shut-down sequence products; distributed and open control systems; flow, level, thermos, and consistency, as well as PH, DO, UV meters; QCS System; pressure and pulp consistency transmitters; control valves, on-off valves / motors, and pumps; flue gas analyzers; and electric, instrumentation panel, and motor control centers. In addition, it offers laser doppler vibrometers; in circuit, motor, and leak testing systems; acceleration sound noise measurement, as well as engine, transmission, and vibration noise analyzers; and goniophotometers. Further, the company provides anechoic chambers, chassis dynamo and retractable turntable products, RF power amplifiers, and line impedance stabilization network; gas and liquid chromatographs, x-ray automatic inspection devices, laser microscope and spectral analyzers, particle counter, and data analyzing systems; electrodynamic vibration testing systems; and temperature and humidity, and environmental stress chambers. Additionally, it offers grid green, building air conditioning, power and water quality continuous monitoring, water treatment monitoring, and control systems; power line communication products; and control and measuring system of shielding machine for tunnel digging. The company is also involved in real estate rental activities. Kyoritsu Electric Corporation was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.

4998.d: Fumakilla Limited manufactures, sells, imports, and exports insecticides, household products, and gardening and commercial products worldwide. It also provides pest control products for stores, factories, and restaurants for business and industry uses. The company was formerly known as Oshimo Kaishundo and changed its name to Fumakilla Limited in 1962. Fumakilla Limited was founded in 1924 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

8046.d: Marufuji Sheet Piling Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale, rental, and repair processing of temporary materials for construction work in Japan. In addition, the company offers RG methods; driving and extraction works; and underground obstruction removal works. The company was formerly known as Marufuji Shoten Corporation and changed its name to Marufuji Sheet Piling Co.,Ltd. in March 1963. Marufuji Sheet Piling Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

The company offers rice ball with salmon roe, salt-grilled mackerel, salt-grilled atka mackerel, octopus, broccoli, and potatoes with basil sauce, chopped octopus, roasted mackerel, mackerel in olive oil, saury and mushroom in olive oil, beef tendon stew, Norwegian mackerel simmered in miso, soft roe, and mussels flavored with garlic butter. It also provides marine ingredients used primarily in rice, bento boxes, pasta, salads, etc. The company sells its products to convenience stores, food manufacturers, and trading companies. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

8737.d: Akatsuki Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate and securities businesses in Japan. The company also develops paid nursing homes; and trunk room rental services. In addition, it is involved in the architectural design and supervision. The company was formerly known as Akatsuki Financial Group, Inc. and changed its name to Akatsuki Corp. in July 2016. Akatsuki Corp. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Canox Corporation was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
